Shop Adrift Welcome to Adrift Tahoe Experience Lake Tahoe’s ultimate paddle sports destination at Adrift Tahoe in Kings Beach, California. Nestled along the scenic shoreline, we offer top-quality paddle board, kayak, and canoe rentals, perfect for exploring the crystal-clear waters. Looking to make paddling a way of life? Browse our curated selection of stand-up paddle boards for purchase, along with premium apparel and must-have outdoor essentials. Whether you're a seasoned adventurer or just dipping your paddle in for the first time, Adrift Tahoe has everything you need to elevate your Lake Tahoe experience. Visit us in Kings Beach today! Check Our Rentals Shop Adrift Tahoe Online Video of Stunning Lake Tahoe Stand Up Paddle Board Adventures, courtesy of Adrift Tahoe, www.adrifttahoe.com. Tahoe’s Original Surf Shop Adrift Tahoe is located on the beach in Kings Beach, CA. We are Tahoe’s original surf shop, celebrating the spirit of Polynesia 6200’ above sea level. Our Adrift brand SUP & Surf Boards, as well as our surf wear label, are inspired by the art and spirit of ancient Polynesian seafarers who set out to explore the farthest reaches of Oceania. Our products celebrate these adventurous way finders. Whether you’re a beginner or an expert paddler, we’ve got the expertise and inventory to provide you with the right board and gear for your skill level, goals, and budget. Grab a board and Go Adrift… Learn More Shop Now What We Do Adrift specializes in stand up paddle sales & rentals, kayak & canoe rentals, and we offer an array of gear, beach wear & sundries. You’ll find everything you need for a fun day at the beach and more. What Our Customers Are Saying “This is definitely the place to go for your local rental needs. Marcus is great, friendly, and super helpful. He will tell you whatever you need to know to have a great day out in the water. If you happen to be in Tahoe when the winds pick up and the surf is firing, they can get you set up with a board and wetsuit since you probably left yours at home. I'll definitely be back.” — David Fujimoto “Rented three 2-person kayaks and had a good time, employees were really friendly. The pricing was also very affordable, they even told us they would only charge us based on 30 minute intervals if we decided that it was too difficult due to the wind picking up.” — Adrian Lombroso “Best rentals at Tahoe! Friendly staff, great prices, and awesome local shop. Right on kings beach and shared parking lot with public beach so SUPER convenient. Quality boards and paddles which were perfect and performed better than most rentals I've used. Two Decades in the Field. Alpenglow Expeditions is an IFMGA-certified mountain guide service founded in 2004 in North Lake Tahoe, California. We lead 60+ international expeditions a year, including guided ascents of Everest, the Seven Summits, and the world’s highest 8,000-meter peaks, plus backcountry skiing, rock climbing, mountaineering courses, and AIARE avalanche education in Lake Tahoe. We were among the first U.S. guide services to require AMGA or IFMGA certification across our entire lead guide team, and one of the few American companies accredited by the AMGA. That standard shapes every decision we make, from how we build a rope team to how we design an acclimatization schedule. Whether it’s your first time on snow or you’re prepping for your third 8,000-meter peak, our job is the same: give you the skills, logistics, and team to get there as safely and efficiently as possible, and to make the journey one you’ll be talking about for years. International Expeditions Lake Tahoe Climbing & Skiing Our Approach RAPID ASCENT™ A safer and more efficient way to climb – exclusive to us. Rapid Ascent™ is an innovative program that combines hypoxic training with precise logistics and small team sizes to reduce expedition time by 30-50%. Minimizing time spent away from home, while greatly increasing the chances of summit success. Rapid Ascent Let’s find the right expedition for you. CONTACT Global Expeditions Everest, 7 Summits and Beyond. Our expeditions are designed to take you climbing, skiing, and trekking to locations you never dreamed possible and our international mountain guides are IFMGA-certified to teach you the skills necessary to summit the tallest peaks. Two Decades in the Field. Alpenglow Expeditions is an IFMGA-certified mountain guide service founded in 2004 in North Lake Tahoe, California. We lead 60+ international expeditions a year, including guided ascents of Everest, the Seven Summits, and the world’s highest 8,000-meter peaks, plus backcountry skiing, rock climbing, mountaineering courses, and AIARE avalanche education in Lake Tahoe. We were among the first U.S. guide services to require AMGA or IFMGA certification across our entire lead guide team, and one of the few American companies accredited by the AMGA. That standard shapes every decision we make, from how we build a rope team to how we design an acclimatization schedule. Whether it’s your first time on snow or you’re prepping for your third 8,000-meter peak, our job is the same: give you the skills, logistics, and team to get there as safely and efficiently as possible, and to make the journey one you’ll be talking about for years. International Expeditions Lake Tahoe Climbing & Skiing Our Approach RAPID ASCENT™ A safer and more efficient way to climb – exclusive to us. Rapid Ascent™ is an innovative program that combines hypoxic training with precise logistics and small team sizes to reduce expedition time by 30-50%. Minimizing time spent away from home, while greatly increasing the chances of summit success. Rapid Ascent Let’s find the right expedition for you. CONTACT Global Expeditions Everest, 7 Summits and Beyond. Our expeditions are designed to take you climbing, skiing, and trekking to locations you never dreamed possible and our international mountain guides are IFMGA-certified to teach you the skills necessary to summit the tallest peaks. pages.text: Kayak Tahoe - kayak and stand up paddleboard rentals at Lake Tahoe Hit enter to search or ESC to close Rentals Locations Links Weather permitting Kayak Tahoe is open daily. Operating hours are 10am - 5pm with the last rentals leaving at 4pm and returning by 5pm. Please be to the location of your choosing no later than 3:45pm for last rentals. Kayak and Standup Paddleboard Rentals Rental Rate Locations Restrictions There is no better way to experience the incredible beauty of Lake Tahoe than from the lake itself. We provide a range of open-deck (sit-on-top) kayaks and paddleboards that are enjoyed by beginners and experts alike. Rental Rates Single Kayak $40.00 1 hour $50.00 2 hours $110.00 Full Day Double Kayak $55.00 1 hour $85.00 2 hours $130.00 Full Day Paddleboard $40.00 1 hour $50.00 2 hours $110.00 Full Day Our Locations Rental Information General Information All rentals for all locations are first-come, first-served and no reservations are available over the phone or on-line. Parking can be an issue so please try and arrive early. Open-deck kayak rentals include life vests, paddles, backrests, and basic instruction. Paddleboard rentals include paddle, leash, life vest and basic instruction. Dry bags are also available at an extra charge. Consumption of alcohol is not permitted at anytime while renting from or interacting with Kayak Tahoe. Cash and Credit Cards only accepted at all locations. Due to high use, reception can be poor. Cash will expedite the rental process. Please bring an ID with you when you come to rent come to rent. Minors MINIMUM age for participants is 4 years old and the participant must weigh over 30 lbs. Minors ages 13 to 17 MUST be watched at all times by a parent/guardian 18 years of age or older. The parent/guardian MUST always stay within earshot of the minor(s). Minors 12 and under MUST be accompanied on the water by a parent/guardian 18 years of age or older. This can be on single kayaks, paddleboards or double kayaks. The minor and parent/guardian can be on a Paddleboard together if the minor is under 90 lbs. Two participants on the same Paddleboard will NOT be allowed to paddle to Fannette Island (Emerald Bay). Participant MUST be over the age of 15 to take their own vessel (kayak or Paddleboard) to Fannette Island (Emerald Bay). Attention Group Leaders Print out a copy of our Liability Form and Rental Contract . Print one copy of the Rental Contract (this is usually filled out by the credit card holder), and then as many Liability Releases as you need for your group (One per person unless you are family). Staple them together for us and you will be on the water faster! Please note this is not a ticket to the front of the waiting line, you will still need to wait in before we can complete the rental process. Have Fun! Additional Things to Remember You will get wet so please wear suitable clothing. Preferably have footwear that can get wet. Please come prepared to rent before you sign up at our table. i.e. Make sure everyone in the group has gone to the bathroom, applied sunscreen, have their food and water and are ready to receive instruction. Children older than 4 years old and under 50lbs can be a third person on a double kayak. Remember to have FUN! Cold Water Consideration Families with small children and anyone affected by cold water should be cautious and realistic about their swimming ability and experience level. We have provided some links below for two of the most common cold water emergencies. Thank you and we hope to see you on the water soon. Cold Water Information Links: Cold Water Shock – National Center for Cold Water Safety Cold Water Shock – National Weather Service Cold Water Shock – SouthTahoeNow.com news article Hypothermia About us 30 years in operation and counting, we love to paddle, and we love to get people on the water. Customer safety and fun are our priorities, come on down and experience it for yourself. The journey starts here! From the sidewalk path along Lake Shore Blvd, playfully dubbed Billionaires Row, to the incredibly restored East Shore Trail, an easy, car-free bike path framing beautiful Lake Tahoe, the bike rides in North Lake Tahoe will thrill everyone. By constantly replenishing our fleet we can always offer bike rentals for all ages, levels and rider types. Get out and get going with us today! Big Blue has a varied fleet for all sizes and abilities City Bikes Discover Lake Tahoe the way it was meant to be explored—by bike. Our comfortable City Bikes are ideal for cruising the world-famous East Shore Trail, where stunning lake views, hidden beaches, and scenic stops await around every turn. Ride at your own pace and create memories that will last a lifetime. Electric Bikes Explore Lake Tahoe with ease on our premium RAD electric bikes. Featuring pedal-assist technology and a half-twist throttle, these powerful e-bikes help you conquer hills, cruise scenic trails, and cover more ground without breaking a sweat. Choose the level of assistance that’s right for you and enjoy a smooth ride with a long-lasting battery designed for all-day adventure. Kids Bikes Make Lake Tahoe a family adventure everyone can enjoy. From young riders ready for their own bike to little ones who prefer to ride along, we have options for every age and stage. With kids bikes, tag-alongs, child trailers, and baby seats available, the whole family can comfortably explore Tahoe’s stunning shoreline and scenic bike paths together. Sport Bikes Designed for riders who want to go farther and explore more, our lightweight sport bikes offer a fast, responsive ride that’s perfect for the East Shore Trail and beyond. Enjoy smooth handling, comfortable positioning, and confident performance as you take in Lake Tahoe’s spectacular scenery. pages.text: Bike Shop | Big Daddy's Bike & Brew | Gardnerville top of page 775-782-7077 BIKES BREWS & TAP FOOD TRUCK FIRE TRUCK SKI & BOARD WINE BARRELS CONTACT More Use tab to navigate through the menu items. SCROLL G'VILLE, NEVADA - EST. 1991 - Home Bike BIKES Where it all began - Circa '91 SALES SERVICE Back in the day, Keith "Big Daddy" Hart opened up shop with one mission in mind: to bring a legit, high quality Bike Shop to the Carson Valley. Over 30 years and thousands of customers later, he realized... "I need to be serving more". Well, he did just that. Enter, Big Daddy's Bike & Brew! BUT , don't get it twisted, Big Daddy's is a Bike Shop to the core ! Everything from Cruisers & E-Bikes to Parts & Service... Big Daddy has you covered! AUTHORIZED DEALER BREWS Peddle on down for a cold one. Or 2? What goes better after a long day of riding? ICE COLD CRAFT BEER! Or, any other type of cocktail. ;) You'll always find something awesome on tap at "The Brew". From local favorites to our very own " DIPADADDY ", Big Daddy's pours a variety of seasonal suds to soothe the soul. NOW POURING: CARSON RIVER BREWING CO. YUP... WE CRAFT OUR OWN BREW. Introducing Carson River Brewing Company! OK... we're still working on the brewery, packaging and so forth. BUT, you don't have to wait to try our KICK ASS brews! Come on down to the Bike & Brew (Official Tap House) and wrap your lips around a pint of our REMEDADDY or soon to be famous DIPADADDY! IF YA' DON'T KNOW, NOW YA' KNOW. Brews FOOD TRUCK FOOD TRUCK Yeah, we've got the grub too. Big Daddy's Bike & Brew has teamed up with Valley Eats! Come on down and check out the full menu! CALL AHEAD TO SEE IF WE'RE SERVIN'! The Truck FIRE TRUCK BREW4U - ON THE SPOT. CALL US TO BOOK YOUR EVENT! 775-782-7077 Big Daddy's Bike & Brew Fire Truck is an entertainment event on wheels, offering: 5 tap handles, an outstanding music system, a full 20-person bar, a dance floor/seating area, and fun for the whole family! You can rent the whole truck (delivered) for the day or by the hour for your special event. We do weddings , birthday parties , graduations , retirement parties , the list is endless! "CHEERS & BEERS" During the month of December, we will be bringing back our famous Christmas "Cheers & Beers" Fire Truck extravaganza! Invite all your friends, family, and neighbors! For just $50, we'll deliver a holiday moment for everyone to enjoy and remember for years! Santa and friends for the kids, singing and dancing, beers and cheers what can be better? SKI & BOARD RUN TO THE HILLS! Big Daddy's offers season as well as daily ski and snowboard rentals and demos ! Skis, boards, boots, poles... the works! Plus, we offer full service tuning and waxing to keep your equipment dialed. To learn more, give us a ring or stop by today! WE OFFER THE LATEST FROM CARSON VALLEY'S ONLY SKI & BOARD TUNING CENTER! Ski + Board Barrells WINE BARRELS AND OTHER AWESOME WOOD CREATIONS As if we weren't busy enough? Big Daddy's also offers full and cut Wine Barrels for your pleasure. Whether using them for your garden - or - crafting some awesome furniture... (hey, we do that too!) we stand and deliver! CONTACT US OR STOP ON BY TO GET YOUR WINE BARREL TODAY! Contact CONTACT US 775-782-7077 Big Daddy's Bike & Brew 1546 U.S. HWY 395 N, Gardnerville, NV 89410 ​ OPEN TUESDAY ~ SATURDAY Mon, Tue, We d: 10 : 00 AM ~ 6:00 PM Thur, Fri, Sat: 10: 00 AM ~ 9:00 PM The Bike & Brew Has been awarded! 2024 Big Daddy's Bike & Brew | Site By MTN4 bottom of page

RENT A BIKE Bike Truckee is pleased to offer a full fleet of bike rentals to meet your recreation needs. Find performance, full-suspension and electric (standard and 24") mountain bikes as well as comfort cruisers, children's bikes, trailers, trail-a-bikes, and tandems . ​ All rentals include a helmet and a bike lock is available upon request. Electric Bikes We have a fleet of comfort road electric bikes that have powerful Bosch mid drive motors to flatten out the steepest of hills. With a range of 35-50 miles these bikes are up for any adventure. Try a tour up around Tahoe Donner or around Donner Lake and up the historic Old Highway 40. RENT NOW Full Suspension Mountain Bikes Our new fleet of Specialized Carbon Stump Jumpers have 150mm of front and rear travel. These 29" wheel bikes are light nimble and are easy riding bikes are up for any trail you want to tackle. RENT NOW Electric Mountain Bikes Feel the uphill flow as you climb hills like never before. Electric mountain bikes allow you to ride farther, faster, and smoother and tackle hills and obstacles that you would not normally attempt on a traditional bike. Multiple pedal assist levels allow you to get the workout you desire at speeds you like. RENT NOW Performance Mountain Bikes We offer a fleet of KHS Tempe 29er mountain bikes with a smooth riding air front shock and hydraulic disc brakes. These bikes are perfect for getting off the pavement and on to the dirt! RENT NOW 24" Electric Mountain Bikes We have the Bulls 24e bike for little shredders ages 8 to about 12 years old. Theses capable bikes sport a Bosch motor, hydraulic disc brakes, and front suspension. These are easy riding bikes and have a 500 w/hr battery that will outlast mom and dad. RENT NOW Comfort Bikes ​ We offer Specialized Roll comfort bikes. These are the ultimate plush ride with a comfy seat, and a comfortable riding position. RENT NOW For The Kids We have 24" wheel bikes for kids as well as 20" wheel bikes for smaller children. These Specialized bikes feature Shimano components and are easy to ride. RENT NOW Trailers These Thule Cadence trailers fit two small children and there is storage in the back for all your goodies. These trailers are rated for up to 100 lbs and are appropriate for children ages 12 months-4 years. RENT NOW Trail a Bikes These are great devices for the little ones who may have a hard time keeping up on their own. Trail-a-bikes are appropriate for children ages 4-9 and have a weight maximum of 80lbs. RENT NOW Shop all Bike Truckee offerings and bring more fun to your daily life. It's typical for the battery capacity range of your Pedego eBike to vary, as with all electric bikes. Several factors can influence your range, such as the pedal assist and/or throttle usage, terrain inclines, weather conditions, the weight of the load, frequent or abrupt starts and stops, and rapid acceleration. To maximize the range of your Pedego eBike, consider adjusting your riding habits and optimizing various factors. Start by using the pedal assist and/or throttle judiciously, particularly on flat terrain, to conserve battery power. When encountering inclines, try to maintain a steady pace and utilize lower assist levels if available to minimize power consumption. Assisting the motor by pedaling up inclines with more effort will lighten the load on the motor and draw less power. Keep an eye on weather forecasts and plan rides during favorable conditions to reduce wind resistance and extreme temperature energy loss. Additionally, minimize the weight of your cargo or belongings carried on the bike to lessen the strain on the battery. Practice smoother acceleration and braking techniques to minimize energy wastage from sudden speed changes and stops. Ensure your bike tires are inflated to the recommended pressure levels as specified in the following the recommended air pressure table. Explore more ways to optimize your battery usage for an enhanced riding experience. By being mindful of these factors and implementing efficient riding strategies, you can extend the range of your Pedego eBike and enjoy longer rides with confidence. Use of an unsuitable charger to charge a lithium ion battery could result in over-heating, fire or even explosion. pages.text: North Tahoe - Black Tie Bike Rentals Summer Winter Call Us: 866.360.6433 Your safety matters to us! We are incorporating CDC and local Health Department guidelines to keep our guests and employees safe. In addition, we are committed to the following: Employees will wear face coverings and practice physical distancing protocols whenever possible. All rental equipment will be sanitized prior to each usage. Our vehicles and physical locations will be thoroughly and frequently disinfected. We’ve added limited and contact free fitting options to ensure maximum safety and peace of mind for both our guests and employees. COVID-19 Operating Procedures The procedures outlined below are designed to safeguard the health and safety of our guests and employees while providing the excellent customer service and outstanding ski and snowboard equipment that Black Tie is known for. DISINFECTION: All tools, workstations, vehicles and shop surfaces are sanitized daily using an EPA-approved microbial disinfectant. PRE-DELIVERY: All rental equipment (including, but not limited to, helmets, skis, snowboards, boots, and poles) is disinfected using an EPA-approved microbial disinfectant while wearing masks before being loaded into a sanitized delivery bag. The vehicle interior is sanitized daily and between any staff transitions. AT DELIVERY: We wear masks to unload and deliver your rental equipment and adhere to social distancing guidelines through this process. Additionally, we sanitize any tools utilized for adjusting bindings, etc. and our paperless waiver system further minimizes contact. Our preference is to conduct fittings in an outdoor environment or open areas (lobby, foyer, garage) when possible. Enhanced procedures to provide limited or contact free boot-fittings are available based on the preference of our clientele. We ask that all guests wear masks throughout the entire fitting. Guests are strongly encouraged to bring their own face covering, but we can provide disposable masks for those in need. AT PICK-UP: Our staff will wear masks and sanitize all returned rental equipment. EMPLOYEE HEALTH SCREENINGS: We are requiring employees to check for COVID symptoms before each shift and to stay home if they feel unwell. In addition, employees will undergo daily temperature checks at the start of each shift. Other Important Notes: We prefer cashless transactions. Gratuities for our delivery technicians can be added to your credit card. Email us at [email protected] or call 866.360.6433 if you have any additional questions about our COVID-19 prevention procedures. Cancellation Policy We also understand the difficulty making decisions during these uncertain times and want you to feel confident in reserving your rental equipment. Black Tie will give a full refund to any guest who cancels their reservation more than 48 hours in advance. Guests who need to adjust their reservations within 48 hours, please reach out to the location you booked with directly. https://blacktiesummer.wpengine.com/#contact We remain committed to delivering the same high quality of service, while doing our part to keep our guests, employees, and communities safe. We can’t wait to see you on the slopes! US ON INSTAGRAM @bluezonesports BlueZone Sports Welcome to BlueZone Sports, Lake Tahoe's premium outdoor gear retailer. Whether on the snow, in the water, on your bike, or exploring while camping and hiking, we are here to help fuel your next adventure. Inspired by the azure blue water of Lake Tahoe, with locations across the Sierra Nevada Mountains, BlueZone Sports was founded on the belief that small, local-based organizations provide more than a product - they provide an experience. With this belief in mind, we built a team of people passionate about recreating in the outdoors and the lifetime of memories produced from being in nature. Our team lives and plays in the mountains near lakes, trails, and ski resorts. Their experience and lifestyle inform every decision when hand selecting products for our stores. Function, style, and quality are considered first with each product you see. Our skis, snowboards, bikes, SUPs, and kayaks are tested in the mountains we live in. Our clothing and footwear are worn exploring the region or relaxing with friends and family reminiscing about a great day outside. As you embark on your adventures solo or with friends and family, we hope you find that our gear, clothing, and footwear perfectly meets your needs. Our team of pros are here to help provide practical tips to inform your purchase, so feel free to contact us online or at one of our shops. US ON INSTAGRAM @bluezonesports BlueZone Sports Welcome to BlueZone Sports, Lake Tahoe's premium outdoor gear retailer. Whether on the snow, in the water, on your bike, or exploring while camping and hiking, we are here to help fuel your next adventure. Inspired by the azure blue water of Lake Tahoe, with locations across the Sierra Nevada Mountains, BlueZone Sports was founded on the belief that small, local-based organizations provide more than a product - they provide an experience. With this belief in mind, we built a team of people passionate about recreating in the outdoors and the lifetime of memories produced from being in nature. Our team lives and plays in the mountains near lakes, trails, and ski resorts. Their experience and lifestyle inform every decision when hand selecting products for our stores. Function, style, and quality are considered first with each product you see. Our skis, snowboards, bikes, SUPs, and kayaks are tested in the mountains we live in. Our clothing and footwear are worn exploring the region or relaxing with friends and family reminiscing about a great day outside. As you embark on your adventures solo or with friends and family, we hope you find that our gear, clothing, and footwear perfectly meets your needs. Our team of pros are here to help provide practical tips to inform your purchase, so feel free to contact us online or at one of our shops. pages.text: Clearly Tahoe | Clear Kayak Tours on Lake Tahoe Skip to primary navigation Skip to content Skip to footer HOME TOURS Open TOURS Menu ALL TOURS PRIVATE GROUP EXPERIENCES BY DATE BY TOUR Open BY TOUR Menu EMERALD BAY TOUR BONSAI ROCK TOUR UNCHARTED TOUR ECO CANOE TOUR LED STARGAZING TOUR LED GLOW TOUR SUMMIT SHORES TOUR SUNSET TOUR POLAR PADDLE TOUR BY LOCATION Open BY LOCATION Menu INCLINE VILLAGE SOUTH LAKE TAHOE ZEPHYR COVE CAMP RICHARDSON RESORT EDGEWOOD TAHOE BY TYPE Open BY TYPE Menu CLEARLY EXPLORER TOURS NIGHT KAYAK TOURS FAMILY FRIENDLY RENTALS Open RENTALS Menu WATER RENTALS Open WATER RENTALS Menu FROM SAND HARBOR FROM OUR ZEPHYR COVE SHOP BIKE RENTALS LEARN MORE Open LEARN MORE Menu ABOUT US EVENTS Open EVENTS Menu EVENT CALENDAR CLEARLY EXPLORER EVENTS SHOWCASE EVENTS CLEARLY TAHOE BLOG PARTNERSHIP OPPORTUNITIES TRANSPORTATION Open TRANSPORTATION Menu ZEPHYR COVE TRANSIT INCLINE VILLAGE TRANSIT TAHOE KEYS TRANSIT SAFETY ACCESSIBILITY SHOP CONTACT US More Open More Menu Menu Pause Play Video Unmute Mute Welcome to Clearly Tahoe – the original home of clear kayak tours on Lake Tahoe. Clearly Tahoe now offers more than 20 full-service recreational experiences from 5 popular Lake Tahoe destinations! Let our highly trained and certified staff guide you on a Clear Kayak Shoreline Tour, an LED Night Stargazing Experience, an Eco Canoe Tour along the marsh or join us for an all inclusive excursion on our 46 foot tri-toon, The Clearly Explorer. Prefer to explore independently? Create your own adventure with one of our premium rentals.We offer the largest and most diverse fleet of paddle craft equipment on Lake Tahoe, along with Pedal Assist Beach Cruisers and Mountain Bikes, Analog Bikes and seasonal Snowshoe Rentals making it easy to explore the outdoors all year long BIKE RENTALS . . Pedal through the Tahoe pines to explore shoreline and beaches connected by forested bike paths on a bike rental! Bike Clearly Tahoe Bike Rentals KAYAK & SUP RENTAL . . Choose from a variety of unique kayaks, paddle boards, and specialty crafts to explore on your own! Available from 2 locations. Paddle Board Kayak and SUP Rentals CLEAR KAYAK TOURS . . Explore the crystal clear waters of Lake Tahoe and depths of up to 75 feet through a completely transparent kayak! Kayak Clear Kayak Shoreline Tours CANOE TOURS . . Paddle a classic style canoe along the shoreline and marsh to learn about Tahoe’s ecosystem and wildlife! Binoculars Guided Eco Canoe Tours EXPLORER TOURS . . Step aboard the Clearly Explorer for a unique all inclusive Clear Kayak experience from our 46 foot Tri-Toon! Anchor Clearly Explorer Charters SHOPPING . . Browse our three adventure themed gift shops and choose the perfect piece of Lake Tahoe to take home with you! Gift Adventure Gift Shops LED NIGHT TOURS . . Kick back and relax as you enjoy the bright night sky, moon-lit Sierras and the ambiance of LED luminescence! Moon LED Night Kayak Tours WINTER ACTIVITIES . . Kayak along the snow covered boulders and experience the crystal clear waters of Lake Tahoe on a guided winter paddle! Snowflake Winter Clear Bottom Kayak Tours Completely Clear Kayak Tour in South Lake Tahoe! NEW - Summit Shores Clear Kayak Tour Departing from the famous Camp Richardson resort this guided paddle in completely clear kayaks allows guests to learn about the rich history and vibrant eco systems of Lake Tahoe’s South shore , all set the the backdrop of old pine forests and the towering Tallac Mountain peak. Book Now Learn More Clearly Tahoe Safety Information At Clearly Tahoe, we believe unforgettable adventures start with a strong foundation of safety and professionalism. Our tours are led by experienced guides who are trained by certified lifeguards and equipped with the skills to navigate Lake Tahoe’s unique and ever changing conditions. Behind every relaxing paddle and stunning scenic moment is a team that takes safety seriously so you can focus on enjoying your time on the water! Whether you’re joining us for a guided tour or planning your own outing, we’ve created a helpful collection of safety resources, including our Safety Blog and an informative Safety Video available in five languages, to help you prepare for your time on the lake. Clearly Tahoe Safety Information (opens in new window) Rated One of the #1 Must Do Activities in Lake Tahoe Absolutely Worth Doing! Ever since I heard about the clear bottom kayak rentals at Lake Tahoe, I wanted to try them. The experience did not disappoint and is absolutely worth doing. Tahoe water is so clear and this unique outing allows you to view the lake in ways that you can’t get anywhere else. Set up was a breeze and the staff was all super kind + friendly. Shout out to Sheridan and Savanna for adjusting the schedule (I truly appreciate the way they coordinate when the conditions aren’t ideal to go out and find a time to reschedule that works for you) and being our group tour guide out on the water. Thank you! I’ll remember this experience, always, and will have to consider doing one of the night excursions in the future. Zac F. Highly recommend to first timers to Tahoe and long time visitors and locals! Had a blast! Went on the Clearly Explorer which is a combo scenic boat ride and clear kayak experience. I was surprised at how cool it was. You could see everything below you including fish. Also saw a bald eagle and other birds. The staff is top notch and really made the experience. I highly recommend this to first timers to Tahoe as well as long time visitors and locals. Laura M. 3rd Timer! This was our 3rd year using Clearly Tahoe for the Bonzai Rock clear kayak tour. The whole staff were amazing. Russ, our guide, was outstanding! He was funny and super knowledgeable about the lake and the region. We will be back again next year!! John Brought a Smile to Everyone's Face The excursion was really great! The staff was so friendly, and every detail was well organized with clear communication. Our Guide on the water, Russ was engaging, informative and brought a smile to everyones face! Alexander S Genuinely passionate about what they do! Had the most magical Lake Tahoe crystal tour ✨ The views, the energy, and the whole experience felt so peaceful and unforgettable. Huge thanks to Bryan and Dave for making it extra special—both were incredibly informative, warm, and genuinely passionate about what they do. They made the journey just as meaningful as the destination. Maria S. Overall exceeds five out of five experience! The best kayaking tour I’ve ever been on! Would highly recommend if anyone is interested in doing clear boat kayaking at Lake Tahoe. When we checked in Pam was great. She got us set up with life vest, and made sure to help put them on and secure them snuggly. Dave was the one taking us to and from the beach. The drive was great very smooth and AC was on full blast in the heat. Dave was super welcoming and pleasant to talk to. Ethan was our tour guide and I can without a doubt say he’s one of the best tour guides I’ve ever had. He made sure to keep us entertained from the moment we got off the shuttle to the moment we got back on he made sure to take phenomenal photos and give us an amazing history lesson about the region. Bikes are available for advance reservation and walk-up daily on a first come, first served basis between 8:00am and 5:00pm (limitations apply). Riders can enjoy a variety of paved and dirt trails right from our location – no transportation is necessary to access beautiful beaches, forests and scenic viewpoint of Lake Tahoe! Explore a variety of bike options from pedal assist mountain bikes to passenger e-bikes and analog (non-electric bikes) for the whole family to enjoy! Whether you’re cruising forest paths or navigating rocky terrain, the Fox front and rear suspension ensure a smooth, responsive ride. Guests will find the idyllic Lake Tahoe backdrop of pristine turquoise waters, enormous granite boulders, and the snow capped Sierra Nevada mountains on the horizon. With a complimentary shuttle service from our check in location to the launch point there is no easier way to guarantee worry free lake access to Tahoe’s most picturesque paddle sites. Tours are available in completely or partially clear kayaks, dependent on the season, and guests can awe at Lake Tahoe’s clarity with depths of up to 65 feet visible below. Activities from this location are beginner friendly and offer a relaxing way guests ages 6 and up to make memories that will last a lifetime. Tours are available by reservation only, but guests can stop by the Clearly Tahoe Shop at anytime to learn more from our on site staff or browse the carefully curated selection of adventure themed gifts, souvenirs and local art. Clearly Tahoe Shop | North 893 Tahoe Boulevard Incline, NV Bonsai Rock | Clear Kayak Tour Activity Type: Guided Tour Duration: 1.5 Hour | 2.5 Hour Activity Time Equipment Type: Completely Clear Kayaks Level of Difficulty: Easy Experience Level: Beginner Pet Friendly: NO Limitations: Ages 6+ Departs From: (Check-in Location) 893 Tahoe Blvd., Incline Village, NV Chevron down Description Description: Paddle through the turquoise-blue water and along the iconic rocky shoreline as you enjoy a 365 degree of the beauty that surrounds you. This guided 1.5 tour will give guests a chance to experience the clarity of Lake Tahoe and visibility of up to 75 feet below the surface through their completely transparent kayak. Participants will have the opportunity to learn about Lake Tahoe as well as how to help preserve and protect it. Inclusions: This guided tour includes shuttle transportation to and from our check in location to the launch site of the scheduled tour. This activity also includes basic instruction from an experienced guide, the use of kayaks, paddles and dry bags as well as a small cooler with complimentary water and granola bars. Clear Kayak(s) and Paddle(s) USCG Approved Life Preserver(s) Basic Instruction Guided Tour Small Cooler Complimentary Water Granola Bars Dry Bags Sunscreen Exclusions: Gratuity Note: There will be complimentary shuttle transportation for this activity. All shuttles are scheduled to depart from our North Clearly Tahoe Shop in Incline Village, NV. Guests must arrive 30 minutes before their scheduled activity for check in. Address below: Incline Village Shop 893 Tahoe Blvd., Ste 800 Incline Village, NV 89451 Chevron down Rates Seating Options: Boats can be seated for 1-2 guests (age and weight limitations apply). Single boats will accommodate 1 guest and Double boats will accommodate two guests. Rate is per person and determined by age and seating arrangement. IMPORTANT NOTE: Combined weight is 375lbs per boat. Children under the age of 12 must ride in a vessel with an adult 18 years of age or older. Per Person Rates: Adult Guest (ages 18+): – Single Rate: $149/ per person – Double Rate: $119/ per person Teen Guest (ages 16-17): – Single Rate: $139/ per person – Double Rate: $109/ per person Youth Guest (ages 12-15): – Single Rate: $129/ per person – Double Rate: $99/ per person Child Guest (child age 6-11): – Double Rate: $89/ per person Additional Fees: *gratuity not included* Chevron down Recommendations Recommendations: This tour is highly recommended for all ages and skill levels 6+ and is an activity the whole family can enjoy together. While it is easy to kick back and relax, this guided tour does require participants to paddle at a reasonable pace to reach destinations in a timely manner. This region of the Lake is said to be our most picturesque and therefore can become very crowded during the summer months. It is best recommended to schedule an experience in the early morning, arrive early and anticipate delays due to traffic and congestion. This tour is NOT RECOMMENDED FOR GUESTS WITH TIME CONSTRAINTS or traveling with pets. What to Wear; Guests should wear comfortable light layers as well as shoes that can be removed easily. We highly recommend hats, sunglasses, and sunscreen, swimsuits are optional but not required. What to Bring; Hat Sunscreen Sunglasses Towel (optional) Camera! Please note: While our guests tend to stay relatively dry during this experience, all participants and belongings are subject to getting wet. Clearly Tahoe is not responsible for any lost or damaged items. Electronics and valuables should be left in a safe place. Chevron down Limitations Level of Difficulty: This tour is suitable for beginners and is generally considered an easy physical activity. Limitations: Limitations do apply to this experience. All participants must be over the age of 6 and there is a weight limit of 375lbs. per boat. Pets will not be permitted on this experience. PLEASE NOTE: There is a mandatory check-in at for this experience. All guests must arrive to our Clearly Tahoe Shop in Incline Village, NV for check-in no less than 30 minutes prior to departure. Please see confirmation email for more information. Details for Physical Requirements: Guests should be able to listen and understand rules, regulations, and safety lecture verbally provided in English. Guests will be required to enter up to 12 inches of water prior to entering the vessel. Guests will be required to enter the vessel one foot at a time and lower themselves to a seated position without assistance. Guests will be required to sit in an upright position and paddle at a reasonable pace with occasional breaks. Guests should be able to remain afloat with the assistance of a PFD and calmly follow instructions of a tour guide in an emergency scenario. Any special requests for guests with disabilities should be referred to [email protected] prior to making a reservation. Please visit the link below for our full Clearly Tahoe Company Policy clearlytahoe.com/company-policy Chevron down Address and Directions Check-in Policy: Guests MUST arrive to our Clearly Tahoe Shop 30 minutes prior to scheduled activity for check-in. All participants must be prepared to complete electronic liability waivers prior to departure. Guests who miss their scheduled check in may miss their tour and will be subject to same day cancellation policies. Address Incline Village Shop 893 Tahoe Blvd., Ste 800 Incline Village, NV 89451 Meeting Location Our North Clearly Tahoe Shop is located in the Village Plaza across from Starbucks in the same building as Sage Leaf restaurant and Vista Trail Bikes. Please note: No parking will be avail

Our Bike Rentals will remain open. We plan to resume operations once conditions improve. Clearly Tahoe Rentals at Sand Harbor State Park are Now Open: 7 days a week from 8:00 am – 6:00 pm (last rental launching at 5:00 pm) All operations are wind and weather permitting and there may be equipment and/or zone limitations, please check the sign at the entrance to the park for daily closure updates or call our office at 530-554-4664 with additional questions. Are you interested in visiting us at the Sand Harbor Nevada State Park? Do you already have an existing Day Use Reservation to enter the park? YES I already have a Day Use Reservation NO I do not have a Day Use Reservation Clearly Tahoe Rentals at Sand Harbor Rentals are available for walk-up on a first come, first served basis to visitors of the Sand Harbor Nevada State Park. Visitors of the park can choose from one of the largest and most diverse rental fleets on Lake Tahoe and enjoy the iconic rocky shoreline and turquoise blue waters right off the beach! Clearly Tahoe offers everything our guests should need during their time on the water from US Coast Guard approved PFDs, paddles, dry bags to even sunscreen! Our incredibly hard-working team will even help carry your boat down to the waters edge and provide a safety briefing. At Clearly Tahoe, safety is our #1 priority so while we do offer a wide array of vessel options, select vessels do have limited paddle regions and a maximum rental duration. Paddle at your own pace and pay for only the time you use at Clearly Tahoe. There is no need to commit to full-day rentals for a discounted rate. Our hourly rental rate drops for each additional hour so you can return your vessel when your finished enjoying the beautiful views! Equipment and Rates Rental Map Rental Information Lake Safety Information At Clearly Tahoe, we believe unforgettable adventures start with a strong foundation of safety and professionalism. Our tours are led by experienced guides who are trained by certified lifeguards and equipped with the skills to navigate Lake Tahoe’s unique and ever changing conditions. Behind every relaxing paddle and stunning scenic moment is a team that takes safety seriously so you can focus on enjoying your time on the water! Whether you’re joining us for a guided tour or planning your own outing, we’ve created a helpful collection of safety resources, including this our Safety Blog and an, informative Safety Video available in five languages, to help you prepare for your time on the lake. About Clearly Tahoe Rentals Clearly Tahoe offers the largest and most diverse rental fleet on Lake Tahoe. Our on-site rentals offer a convenient way to enjoy recreational paddling without the need to transport vessels around the lake. We are located within the Sand Harbor Nevada State Park. Park entry is required to enjoy a Clearly Tahoe rental from this location. How to Get a Rental All of our on-site rentals within the Sand Harbor Nevada State Park are on a first come, first served basis (wind and weather permitting). While we rarely run out of rental equipment, we highly recommend arriving early for the best paddle conditions on Lake Tahoe, the best selection of vessel options and for the shortest wait times to obtain a rental. Plan Ahead – Make a Day Use Reservation Make advance reservations to enter the Sand Harbor Nevada State Park by visiting reservenevada.com and making a Day Use Reservation online. Guests who make a reservation are still advised to arrive early (between 8am and 9am) between Memorial Day and Labor Day for the best selection and overall experience. What if Day Use Reservations are Not Available? Guests who can not make a Day Use Reservation to the Sand Harbor Nevada State Park may find another way to enter the park to enjoy a Clearly Tahoe Rental (wind and weather permitting). Alternative methods of park entry vary by season. Rental Options and Rates Kayak Explore the Clearly Tahoe Rental Fleet Clearly Tahoe Rental FAQ Info Learn More about Clearly Tahoe Rentals Sand Harbor Live Camera Info Check Conditions at Clearly Tahoe Rental Concession (opens in new window) Plan Ahead Info Safety Tips and Weather Guidelines Reserve Park Entry Now Ticket Make a Day Use Reservation for Sand Harbor (opens in new window) Learn More about Entry to Sand Harbor Info FAQ About Day Use Reservations (opens in new window) Alternative Park Entry Options Info Seasonal Recommendaitons for Entry to Sand Harbor Sand Harbor Location Location Address and Directions to the Sand Harbor Nevada State Park (opens in new window) What if there is no availability for a Day Use Reservation? The Sand Harbor Nevada State Park may permit same-day vehicle entry on a first come, first serve basis after 10:30am until capacity is reached. It is very rare to obtain park entry this way between Memorial Day and Labor Day. If visiting the Sand Harbor Nevada State Park between Memorial Day and Labor Day, it is strongly advised to plan for alternative options. IMPORTANT: Walk-ins through the main gate and drop-offs via ride share (such as Uber, Lift and LakeLink) are not permitted. Do not attempt to walk-in along Hwy 28 to Sand Harbor or take a ride share to the Sand Harbor Nevada State Park. Alternative Methods of Park Entry to the Sand Harbor Nevada State Park (if you can’t make a Day Use Reservation) Enjoy a Walk or Bike Ride along the 3-Mile East Shore Trail Take the FREE East Shore Express Shuttle from Incline Village, NV (Available June 22nd – September 6th) East Shore Express Shuttle Bus Lake Tahoe Transportation District (opens in new window) 3 Mile East Shore Trail Walking Visit All Trails for More Information (opens in new window) 3 Mile East Shore Trail Guests who wish to visit the Sand Harbor Nevada State Park can park at Tunnel Creek Café in Incline Village, Nevada and enjoy a scenic 3-mile walk down the beautiful East Shore Trail. This trail is renowned for is breathtaking views of Lake Tahoe and opens to a variety of lake-access points along the way. This paved trail has access to restrooms, benches and informative stops along the route to Sand Harbor. It is important to note that visitors hoping to enter the park by walking the East Shore Trail to Sand Harbor will be charged a $2.00 park entry fee per person. Only cash is accepted, and it is recommended to have the exact amount ready as they may not be able to make change at the gate. Additionally, pets are not permitted within park boundaries. Tips for East Shore Trail: Consider biking along the East Shore Trail instead of walking. Bike rentals are available at Tunnel Creek Café and at a variety of other locations in Incline Village, NV Plan to arrive to the park early for the best selection of vessels and overall rental experience. Bring $2.00 cash per person for park entry fee at the gate. Carry water on the trail and stay hydrated during the walk/bike ride. Protect yourself from the sun with hats, sunglasses and sunscreen. Light layers are best recommended for this walk as well as comfortable footwear that can be removed while kayaking. Less is more, bring only what you need. There is a restaurant on-site within the park (season and hours of operation for the Kokanee Bar and Grill vary) Bring and ID and Credit Card to rent a vessel at our Clearly Tahoe rental concession within the park. East Shore Express Shuttle During the High Season (June 22 nd – September 6 th ) the Lake Tahoe Transportation District offers FREE Public transportation to the Sand Harbor Nevada State Park via the East Shore Express Shuttle from Incline Village, NV. The shuttle runs on a continuous loop from 10:00am to 3:00pm transporting visitors from the 76 Gas Station (corner of Northwood Blvd. & Tahoe Blvd./SR 28) in Incline Village NV to the park. Best Recommended Option For: Those visiting Lake Tahoe during High Season (June 22 nd – September 6 th ) Visitors with time constraints. Persons who may not be physically willing/able to walk or bike the East Shore trail. Tips for East Shore Express Shuttle: Guests may be required to stand in the shuttle. Large items are not permitted in the shuttle such as coolers, beach umbrellas or inflatables. Public parking for the East Shore Express can fill quickly. Street parking may be available but may require visitors to walk an unknown distance to reach the shuttle pick-up area. Do not park in temporary parking areas or small business parking lots with limited parking space. Plan to exit the park before the last shuttle. Do not wait until the last westbound shuttle to leave the park at 6:00pm. It may not have space for everyone. Guests who miss the last shuttle may have to walk the 3 mile East Shore Trail back to Incline Village, NV. Rental FAQ – Clearly Tahoe Rentals Skip to primary navigation Skip to content Skip to footer CLEARLY TAHOE HOME RENTALS HOME RENTAL INFORMATION Open RENTAL INFORMATION Menu RENTAL INFORMATION RENTAL RATES RENTAL FAQ HOURS AND LOCATION RENTAL USE MAP ABOUT SAND HARBOR LIVE WEB CAM CLEARLY TAHOE TOURS Open CLEARLY TAHOE TOURS Menu ALL TOURS BY LOCATION Open BY LOCATION Menu INCLINE VILLAGE ZEPHYR COVE SOUTH LAKE TAHOE BIKE RENTALS CONTACT More Open More Menu Menu Frequently Asked Questions Clearly Tahoe Rentals from the Sand Harbor Nevada State Park General Questions Chevron down How do I get a rental? Clearly Tahoe’s rental concession is first-come, first served ONLY. We do not take reservations for rental equipment. Walk up to our concession Stand in Sand Harbor State Park and launch a rental right from the beach! Chevron down What type of equipment do you have? Clearly Tahoe offers one of the largest and most diverse rental concessions on Lake Tahoe. Visitors within the Sand Harbor Nevada State Park can choose from a variety of rental options (weather and season permitting). All of our available rentals, limitations and pricing can be found here . Chevron down What is a full-service rental? Clearly Tahoe offers full-service rentals within the Sand Harbor Nevada State Park which enables guest to enjoy a rental right from the beach while eliminating any of the pre planning, accessory purchases or labor intensive work that might be required for kayaking on your own or with an off-site rental company. Clearly Tahoe Includes; – Vessel(s) – 1 USCG PFD per seat – 1 Paddle per seat – 1 Dry Bag per boat – Transport – Assistance with seat adjustments. – Courtesy weather checks and recommendations. – Safety Brief prior to departure – Complimentary on-beach lesson if necessary. – Post cleaning/draining of all vessels, equipment and accessories Chevron down Can I take my rental to another location? No. But that’s ok, you won’t want to when you see where we’re located! Clearly Tahoe offers rentals on-site within the Sand Harbor Nevada State Park. Visitors can enjoy the white sandy beaches, turquoise blue waters and giant granite boulders during their ENTIRE rental experience. Guests never have to transport vessels on their car to reach a destination, and if you did, you likely would not be able to re-enter the park to return the equipment. Chevron down How far can I go? Clearly Tahoe sets daily use limitations that are determined by the season, wind and weather forecast. Vessels may have their own more restricted limitations on use. All of our rental Zones offer beautiful views of the white sandy Tahoe beaches, turquoise blue waters and the iconic giant granite boulders. TIP: – Non-self bailing vessels can generally go a greater distance. – Good weather days will be subject to less restrictions. (less than 5mph winds all day) – Warmer weather months will have less use restrictions. – Avoid buys holiday weekends with increased boat activity. – Have experience. Don’t attempt to go far if you have never kayaked on Lake Tahoe before (even if it is permitted). Chevron down When does Sand Harbor require reservations? Sand Harbor Nevada State Park requires reservations into the park between April 15th and October 15th from 8 am to 10:30 am daily. You can make a reservation by visiting here Chevron down What if I dont have a reservation? After 10:30 am Sand Harbor lets vehicles into the park on a first-come, first-served basis. During peak season and on weekends it is extremely rare to get a parking spot this way as the park reaches capacity quickly. Here are some other options if you do not have a reservation: Take the East Shore Trail: P ark at Tunnel Creek Café in Incline Village, Nevada and enjoy a scenic 3-mile walk down the breathtaking East Shore Trail. Those willing to walk or bike this paved trail will have access to restrooms, benches and informative stops along the route to Sand Harbor. Visitors hoping to enter the park by walking the East Shore Trail to Sand Harbor will be charged a $2.00 park entry fee per person. East Shore Express Shuttle: OPERATES FROM JUNE 22 – SEPTEMBER 6 The Lake Tahoe Transportation District offers FREE Public transportation to the Sand Harbor Nevada State Park via the East Shore Express Shuttle from Incline Village, NV. The shuttle runs on a continuous loop from 10:00am to 6:30pm transporting visitors from the 76 Gas Station (corner of Northwood Blvd. & Tahoe Blvd./SR 28) in Incline Village NV to the park. Chevron down Can I bring a dog? No. Clearly Tahoe does not permit pets of any kind on any of our rentals from the Sand Harbor Nevada State Park. No exceptions. NOTE: Our Scenic Shoreline Tour from Zephyr Cove, NV is our ONLY pet-friendly experience a this time and welcomes small well behaved dogs under 30lbs with advance reservation. Chevron down Can I fly a drone? No. Drones are not permitted within the Sand Harbor Nevada State Park. Permits to fly a drone or to shoot professionally must be obtained through the State of Nevada, Division of State Parks and will be subject to all Federal and Park regulations. Chevron down Can I jump off the kayak and swim? While enjoying a Clearly Tahoe rental, guests are welcome to swim if desired however, it is strongly advised to keep a PFD on to avoid cold water shock, stay near shore, have a buddy with you and be absolutely certain you will be able to get back in/on your vessel (some equipment can be difficult to enter from the water). Rental Map – Clearly Tahoe Rentals Skip to primary navigation Skip to content Skip to footer CLEARLY TAHOE HOME RENTALS HOME RENTAL INFORMATION Open RENTAL INFORMATION Menu RENTAL INFORMATION RENTAL RATES RENTAL FAQ HOURS AND LOCATION RENTAL USE MAP ABOUT SAND HARBOR LIVE WEB CAM CLEARLY TAHOE TOURS Open CLEARLY TAHOE TOURS Menu ALL TOURS BY LOCATION Open BY LOCATION Menu INCLINE VILLAGE ZEPHYR COVE SOUTH LAKE TAHOE BIKE RENTALS CONTACT More Open More Menu Menu Safety Video At Clearly Tahoe, we believe unforgettable adventures start with a strong foundation of safety and professionalism. Our tours are led by experienced guides who are trained by certified lifeguards and equipped with the skills to navigate Lake Tahoe’s unique and ever changing conditions. Behind every relaxing paddle and stunning scenic moment is a team that takes safety seriously so you can focus on enjoying your time on the water! Whether you’re joining us for a guided tour or planning your own outing, we’ve created a helpful collection of safety resources, including this our Safety Blog and an, informative Safety Video available in five languages, to help you prepare for your time on the lake. Rental Map Please view our Rental Map below for safety tips and rental zones. Rental Region may be limited to specific paddle area defined as "Zones 1 -3" below. Please view vessel limitations for zone guidelines. Note: All rentals area subject to Zone Limitations in the event of unfavorable weather conditions. Vessel Limitations ZONE 1: Transparent Paddleboard Completely Clear Kayaks (Wind and weather permitting.) ZONE 2: Classic Canoe (Wind and weather permitting.) ZONE 3: Clear Bottom Kayaks Wooden Paddleboards (Wind and weather permitting.) NO LIMITATIONS: Sit-on-Top Kayaks Standard Paddleboards Pedal Kayak Touring Kayak Tandem Island Floating Lounge (Wind and weather permitting.) Safety Tips ALTITUDE AWARENESS Bring lots of water and stay hydrated during your paddle. Lake Tahoe sits at an elevation of 6,224 feet above sea level. The altitude can result is increased sun exposure, exhaustion and dehydration. WATCH FOR WAVES Wind and weather conditions can change rapidly on Lake Tahoe. Watch for change in weather conditions and if the water gets choppy, begin making your way back toward the launch lane. Distance yourself from rocks if the water begins to get choppy and never get between a rock and your vessel. COLD WATER SHOCK Cold water shock can be deadly and is subject to affecting anyone,of any age and skill level at any time of the year. Remember to keep lifejackets on and secured at all times (Adults and Children) and keep your eyes on your paddle partner(s). DEPTH PERCEPTION The water levels are rapidly changing and may differ greatly from season to season. Paddle ashore sandy beaches and keep a distance from the rocky shoreline. Do not dive from the rocks, trees, cliffs or structures. RESPECT THE ENVIORNMENT Lake Tahoe is home to rare and endangered species that can only be found within the basin. Stay on the trails, and public beaches. Remember to pack it in, pack it out and leave no trace while adventuring in Tahoe. Do not attempt to approach or feed the wildlife. Fun Facts Lake Tahoe is the 2nd deepest lake in the United States and known for it’s crystal clear waters and iconic rocky shoreline. The deepest point of the Lake is South of Crystal Bay and measures 1,645 feet. In 2020 UC Davis reported visibility of 62.9 feet, a record low from when researchers began measuring clarity 53 years ago. Many local organizations are continuously working to preserve and improve the clarity of Lake Tahoe. Locals and visitors to the Lake Tahoe area can help prevent the spread of invasive species by cleaning, draining and drying recreational equipment between use. For more information; visit us online at https://clearlytahoe.com/sustainability/ Lake Tahoe measures 22 miles long and 12 miles wide with 72 miles of shoreline to explore. It takes an average of 6 days to paddle the circumference of Lake Tahoe. The average water temperature of Lake Tahoe is 55.2°F. Because of the depth, Lake Tahoe never freezes over but can reach a low of 40°F in the winter and a high of nearly 63°F during the summer months. Lake Tahoe is filled entirely from rain water and snow melt. There are 63 tributaries running into the lake, a natural filtration system in addition and a granite base keep the water clean and crystal clear. The water in Lake Tahoe is 99.994% pure. That is almost as clean as bottled water. Participants must abide by all seating capacities and combined weight restrictions. Guests will not be permitted to share seats during activity. No glass bottles will be permitted in waterfront areas or while using recreational vessels. Special Use Permit for an “unmanned aircraft” must be obtained through the State of Nevada, Division of State Parks. All FAA restrictions apply. Early birds and nature lovers can join a sunrise Eco Tour in classic canoes to learn more about Tahoe’s wild life. The Clearly Explorer offers all inclusive excursions – launching clear kayaks to tour directly from our 46-foot tri-toon. The Clearly Explorer grants guests easy access to paddle Emerald Bay’s famed waters on our Emerald Bay Tour , the option to venture to uncharted destinations of untouched shoreline for a more adventurous experience on the Uncharted Tour , or a relaxing wind down to the day on the Sunset Excursion . This location also serves as a hub for afternoon and evening experiences. Those looking for a truly unique way to end their day can take part in an evening or nighttime LED Kayak Tour – perfect for relaxing and paddling beneath Tahoe’s breathtaking night skies. Clearly Tahoe Keys Marina 2435 Venice Drive East South Lake Tahoe, CA Clearly Explorer | Emerald Bay Clear Kayak Tour Activity Type: Guided Cruise & Clear Kayak Experience Duration: 3 Hour | 4 Hour Activity Time Equipment Type: Completely Clear Kayaks Level of Difficulty: Easy Experience Level: Beginner Pet Friendly: NO Limitations: Ages 4+ Departs From: (Check-in Location) 2435 Venice Drive E., South Lake Tahoe, CA Chevron down Description Description: Explore Lake Tahoe’s most iconic location from two different perspectives! Departing from South Lake Tahoe, this unique 3-hour adventure takes guests on a cruise across crystal-clear waters to reach one of Lake Tahoe’s most sought after paddle destination. Upon arrival to Emerald Bay, the clear kayaks are launched directly from the boat for a guided tour of the bay’s dazzling waters and rich history. Enjoy endless views of granite cliffs and towering peaks above and glittering blue green hues below! The Clearly Explorer gives guests the opportunity to enjoy Tahoe’s longest point to point clear kayak paddle, with the knowledge and expertise of trained guides on the water and close by comfort of the larger vessel. Aboard, guests can enjoy complimentary amenities, a restroom, complimentary snacks, everything needed for a relaxing and immersive day on the water. Leg Powered What sets us apart from anyone else on the lake are our Hobie kayaks. The Mirage Drive pedal system allows you to choose if you want to use your legs or paddle traditionally. It’s easy to operate, and you can just use the Mirage Drive foot pedals if casually enjoying time on the lake is your thing. Why fight for a beach when you can be on your own island? Rated #1 tour in Stateline on TripAdvisor! Single Kayak Anthony was great. We had originally booked for Saturday, but there was going to be a small craft advisory that day. He called us Friday morning to see if we could switch days, so we could still go out. He was friendly, knowledgeable and on time when we met. It was a lot of fun, and I would highly recommend him. FarAway83034, TripAdvisor High quality kayaks, high quality service We wanted to rent a kayak to use at our vacation house, and Anthony set us up beautifully. He took the time to load up the kayak and then picked it up the next day. The area around Cave Rock, where Anthony operates from, is the perfect place to kayak - so beautiful! We will certainly call Anthony when we return to Lake Tahoe! Anne P., TripAdvisor Awesome Experience The Hobie Mirage kayaks are perfect for exploring the lake! Anthony was very helpful and would recommend to anyone who wants to spend a day on the water without having to manage the oars and constant rowing with a traditional kayak. Sherry Q., TripAdvisor Tahoe vibe Couldn’t have asked for more. Professional service with local feel. The pedal kayak is by far the best for parents with a small passenger! Will do it again and again. Note, the State Park where you park has a nice sand beach for hanging out with kids. Bring a picnic lunch and enjoy-you paid $10 to park. Electric Bike Rental Half Day / Full Day Toddler Seats, Equipment / Pet Trailers, Pet Carriers, Belongings Baskets are available until supplies last. Includes: Phone holder, rear storage bungee and / or straps, water bottle holder, properly sized helmet, combination style bike lock. Rad Runner 3+ Electric Trike Rental (Hourly / Half Day / Full Day) Equipment / Pet Trailers, Pet Carriers, Belongings Baskets are available while supplies last. Includes: Phone holder, rear storage bungee and / or straps, water bottle holder, properly sized helmet, combination style bike lock. Staring at $65 half day / $100 full day Weight capacity is 415 pounds. Height range is 4’10”-6’4”. Clear Kayak Tour Daily at Sand Harbor During our tour you will get the chance to encounter Lake Tahoe from a whole new perspective. We will spend 2 hours on the lake exploring the beautiful sandy eastern shoreline and viewing some of the most photographed and iconic granite boulders on the lake. Includes: Clear kayaks, Paddles, Lifejackets, Dry Bags, Shuttle into the Park (even when the park is closed) and Park Entrance Fee. Starting at $150 per Person. Double Kayak 1 Day (up to 24 hr) Includes: kayak, paddle, seat, dry bag, life jackets, straps for transport $75.00/Day Roof padding and straps are included if necessary, and we demonstrate how to do it 😉 Stable and can carry up to 500 pounds (dogs, kids …), can also be paddled as a single. Double Inflatable Kayak 1 Day (up to 24 hr) Includes: kayak, pump, paddle, seats, dry bag, life jackets. $75.00/Day Stable and can carry up to 500 pounds (dogs, kids …), weighs 34 lbs Double Inflatable Kayak 1 Day (up to 24 hr) Includes: kayak, pump, paddle, seats, dry bag, life jackets. $75.00/Day Stable and can carry up to 500 pounds (dogs, kids …), weighs 30 lbs Single Inflatable Kayak 1 Day (up to 24 hr) Includes: kayak, pump, paddle, seats, dry bag, life jackets. $60.00/Day Stable and can carry up to 300 pounds (dogs, kids …), weighs 24 lbs Single Kayak 1 Day (up to 24 hr) Includes: kayak, paddle, seat, dry bag, life jackets, straps and padding for transport $60.00/Day We demonstrate how to do it, carrys up to 350 pounds, can stack two and sometimes three on a roof Stand Up Paddleboard 1 Day (up to 24 hr) Includes: SUP, paddle (for sup and kayak), kayak seat , dry bag, life jackets, pump, backpack $60.00/Day Can carry up to 350 pounds, can easily fit four in a sedan, 6 in an SUV, wieghs 28 pounds Many of our Guests choose Inflatable Kayak/SUP Hybrids enabling them to cherrypick the best beaches all around Tahoe. They come rolled up into a backpack and are ready for short hikes to quiter, more remote destinations. We have complimentary Dog Lifejackets 😉 SAND HARBOR – Sand Harbor can regularly reach 2/3 parking capacity and closes to new parking visitors until later in the afternoon (3-5pm ish). Guests wanting to get to sand harbor can ride the East Shore Express located 100m from our store with Inflatable Models, or Bike into the park from our store even when the park is closed to cars! We allow our guests to pick up rental equipment the evening before their rental so they can get into Sand Harbor early if that is their plan. PARKING along the East Shore of Lake Tahoe – Park Parallel, outside of the No Parking Zones (even if 20 other cars do, there is no safety in numbers, they will all get tickets!), keep your tires off the white (fog) line, mark your parking spot with a pin on your map so you can find it on the way back, take any one of the unmarked trails leading to the lake. East Shore BATHROOMS are located at Chimney Beach Parking lot, Secret Cove parking lot, half way between it secret cove, and just passed creek beach there is a port o pottie. East Shore Beaches – Hidden Beach, Spooners Cove, Memorial Point cove, Sand Harbor (boat Beach, Divers Cove, Main Beach), Bonsai Rock, Lady Bug Beach, Cave Beach, Thunderbird Beach, Pi Rock, Chimney Beach, Secret Cove, Speedboat Beach, Creek Beach, Whale Beach, and Skunk Harbor. Our family had rented a boat on Lake Tahoe, and despite considering myself reasonably boating-savvy, I nearly ran us aground on a submerged rock formation near Emerald Bay. Only a last-minute warning from another passing vessel prevented what would have been a vacation-ending accident. That experience taught me a powerful lesson: when it comes to enjoying Lake Tahoe's crystalline waters, having a USCG licensed captain at the helm transforms your entire experience from potentially stressful to genuinely magnificent. While the allure of piloting your own vessel across America's most magnificent alpine lake might seem tempting, I've discovered through both personal mishap and subsequent captained adventures that the premium boat experience with a professional captain delivers incomparable value, safety, and enjoyment. ‍ Hidden Challenges of Navigating Lake Tahoe Unlike driving a car, navigating Tahoe's 22-mile length presents unique challenges unfamiliar to most visitors. The high-altitude conditions create weather patterns that can shift dramatically within minutes. Sudden afternoon winds frequently generate whitecaps that transform calm morning waters into challenging conditions. Furthermore, Tahoe's underwater topography contains numerous hazards not immediately visible to the untrained eye: Shallow reefs that can damage propellers and hulls Submerged rocks that appear suddenly in seemingly deep areas Unexpected sandbars that locals have spent years learning to navigate Local Knowledge You Can't Download When we hired our first captained boat rental from a premier Lake Tahoe operator, the difference became immediately apparent. Our captain, Mike, possessed not only the requisite USCG license but also thirty years of local knowledge that no navigation app could possibly contain. "I watched a family last summer spend their entire day trying to find Secret Cove, motoring back and forth while burning through their fuel. With a captain, you go straight to the magic spots without wasting precious vacation time." – Mike, Lake Tahoe Captain He comprehended wind patterns instinctively, identified wildlife we would have otherwise missed, and navigated directly to secluded coves inaccessible to most tourists. Safety That Justifies the Investment The safety advantages alone justify the additional investment. Tahoe's elevation (6,225 feet) affects both boat performance and human judgment in ways many visitors don't realize: Thinner atmosphere impacts engine efficiency Accelerates the effects of alcohol consumption Creates rapidly changing weather conditions Extremely cold water temperatures even in summer Professional captains maintain sobriety, understand high-altitude boating adjustments, and continuously monitor weather conditions that untrained eyes might miss until too late. The Family Advantage: Everyone Gets to Enjoy For families, the benefits multiply exponentially. Rather than having one person permanently designated as driver (and therefore restricted from fully enjoying themselves), everyone aboard can participate equally in the experience. Parents can focus entirely on creating memories with their children instead of dividing attention between navigation and supervision. The statistical reality supports this choice as well—according to Coast Guard reports, nearly 70% of boating accidents involve operators with no formal training. Beyond Transportation: An Educational Adventure Beyond safety and logistics, the experiential enhancement proves most compelling. Lake Tahoe encompasses a rich tapestry of natural history, geology, and ecological significance that remains largely invisible without knowledgeable interpretation. Our captain pointed out: Osprey nests we would have cruised past unknowingly Geological processes that formed Tahoe's incredible clarity Fascinating historical anecdotes about the Washoe indigenous people Stories of early European settlers and Tahoe's development He transformed what would have been merely a scenic boat ride into an educational adventure that enriched our understanding of this natural treasure. Premium Vessels, Expert Handling The practicalities favor captained experiences as well. Most professional operators include premium vessels maintained to exacting standards—boats specifically selected for Tahoe's conditions and passenger comfort. Their intimate familiarity with the lake allows efficient routing that maximizes your time at the most spectacular locations while avoiding congested areas. They handle all technical aspects—launching, docking, anchoring, equipment operation—allowing your group to focus exclusively on enjoyment rather than logistics. Customized Experiences for Every Group The customization possibilities expand dramatically with a captain's assistance. Whether your priority involves: Fishing prime locations only locals know about Finding secluded swimming coves away from crowds Photographing wildlife at optimal times Experiencing Tahoe's legendary sunset alpenglow Professional captains adjust the experience to your specific preferences. They accommodate mobility-restricted passengers with appropriate boarding assistance, provide child-friendly experiences for families, or create sophisticated cocktail cruises for adult groups—versatility impossible with standard rental packages. Environmental Stewardship The environmental stewardship aspect deserves consideration as well. Professional captains demonstrate proper protocols for: Minimizing wake in sensitive shoreline areas Maintaining appropriate distances from wildlife Preventing contamination of Tahoe's legendary clarity Their dedication to preservation ensures your enjoyment doesn't compromise the lake's ecological integrity. The Magic Moment: Why We'll Never Go Back to Self-Piloted Our experience culminated with what our captain called the "golden hour cruise"—a perfectly timed excursion positioning us precisely where Mount Tallac's shadow created the most dramatic contrast against the evening alpenglow. As we glided across waters that transitioned from sapphire to molten gold, champagne glasses in hand with absolutely nothing to worry about, the value of our captained experience became unmistakably clear. For families especially, the ability to create these magical Lake Tahoe memories without navigation stress proves transformative. Children remember the uninterrupted attention from parents, the fascinating wildlife spotting guided by expert eyes, and the confidence to leap from the boat into pristine waters without concern. Choosing Your Captained Lake Tahoe Experience When selecting your captained Lake Tahoe experience, several considerations merit attention: Verify legitimate USCG licensing rather than merely "experienced operators" Inquire about the specific vessel —premium experiences typically feature late-model boats with comprehensive amenities Discuss customization possibilities in advance, as the best operators willingly tailor trips to your group's specific interests Ask about local knowledge —the best captains have decades of experience on Tahoe specifically The Bottom Line: Value Beyond Price While self-piloted rentals maintain their appeal for experienced boaters with extensive Lake Tahoe familiarity, for the vast majority of visitors, captained rentals deliver substantially greater value. If you’re looking for a fun and family friendly way to enjoy the lake, tubing should be at the top of your list. Here’s your full guide to tubing in Lake Tahoe, including where to go, how to rent and how to stay safe while having fun. 1. What is Tubing and Why It’s a Tahoe Favorite Tubing is riding an inflatable tube that’s towed behind a boat at high speeds. It’s good for kids, teens and adventurous adults alike. Whether you want smooth glides or bouncing across the wake, tubing is as fun as you want to make it. 2. Best Areas for Tubing on Lake Tahoe Emerald Bay : Scenic and popular but can be crowded midday Carnelian Bay : More relaxed waters, perfect for families Zephyr Cove : Favorite for groups staying on the Nevada side Meeks Bay : Great visibility and fewer boats in the morning 3. Where to Rent Tubes and Tow Boats Many boat rental companies offer tubing gear as an add on: Tahoe Sports : Full range of towable tubes with any powerboat rental Action Watersports : Packages for tubing and parasailing Camp Richardson Marina : Affordable tubing options near South Lake Always confirm: Type of tube (single, double, banana style) Tow rope availability Horsepower of the boat (you’ll want at least 150 HP for good tubing) 4. Tubing Safety Tips Always wear a life jacket (non negotiable for all riders) Have a spotter on board to watch the rider Establish hand signals (thumbs up/down to control speed)* Don’t tube near shallow water or heavy boat traffic Limit rides to 15–20 minutes to avoid fatigue 5. Best Times and Conditions for Tubing Mornings (8 a.m.–11 a.m.) are the calmest Avoid windy afternoons and weekend boat traffic Water is cold so wetsuits are optional but recommended in early summer 6. What to Bring Towels and dry clothes GoPro or waterproof phone case for videos Snacks and water Sunscreen and sunglasses with straps Conclusion Tubing in Lake Tahoe is a must do for thrill seekers and families. With great scenery, good rental options and safe practices you’ll have a blast on the water. Choose the right spot, rent the right gear and let the lake do the rest. We highly recommend closed-toe shoes. Be prepared for any inclement weather by bringing a jacket or other warm clothes. Bike Rentals FAQ What is your refund policy? You can cancel up to 24 hours before your reservation for a full refund. Call us to make a change at 970-754-0033 for U.S. reservations or 800-766-0449 for Canadian reservations. If you can, have your confirmation number handy. Can I change my rental dates after I book? Yes. We understand plans change. We're happy to modify your reservation up to 24 hours in advance. Call us to make a change at 970-754-0033 for U.S. reservations or 800-766-0449 for Canadian reservations. If you can, have your confirmation number handy. Do you rent helmets? Absolutely. For your safety, all rentals include a helmet. We have adult and kids sizes available for every bike rental. What should I wear? We recommend wearing layers you can remove as needed and packing rain gear or wind protection. Consider bringing a backpack to store any extra items and a water bottle if you're cruising around town. Do you rent kids' bikes? Most locations have kids bikes available; sizes may be limited. What time can I pick up my half-day morning rental? Generally, half-day morning rentals are 10 AM 2 PM. This can vary by location, so confirm the exact times with your rental shop. What time can I pick up my half-day afternoon rental? Generally, half-day afternoon rentals are 2 PM 6 PM. This can vary by location, so confirm the exact times with your rental shop. Do you rent protective gear aside from helmets? Yes, for certain bike park and downhill bike rentals. These options include knee and elbow pads and body armor and can be selected in Step 3. Are there mountain bike trails for beginners? Most locations have mountain bike trails for beginners. Ask a team member for their trail recommendations based on your experience and comfort level. What happens if I get a flat tire? Safety first. Dismount and move your bike to a safe place. Then, call the rental shop. We'll help fix your flat and get you back out there. We recommend bringing a cell phone and adding the shop's number before you begin your ride. What times of the year do you rent bikes? Typically, May through August, but this can vary by weather conditions and resort. For your safety, some trails may be closed early in the season. Can we bike on the ski resort property? At most resorts, yes. Check current conditions and for any trail restrictions before your visit. Several resorts also have chairlifts that carry you and your bike up the mountain so you can ride down single-track trails or ski runs. Resorts like Whistler Blackcomb, Keystone, Northstar and more have bike parks. My child is coming with a group, but I will not accompany him or her. Is there a liability waiver I need to sign? We require a parent or legal guardian to sign a release of liability on behalf of an unaccompanied person younger than 18 years old. Download, complete and print this waiver and send it with your child. They will not be able to participate if the release is not signed. No exceptions. Are there weight limits on your bikes? Yes, each manufacturer will set a maximum rider weight to ensure the safety of riders please contact your preferred rental store directly to confirm the maximum rider weight for the bike you're interested in renting.
