pages.text: The Biggest Little ATV Shop The Biggest Little ATV Shop Home Contact Sand Paddle Rentals Photos FAQ Home Contact Sand Paddle Rentals Photos FAQ Top Rated ATV and UTV Repair in the Northern Nevada Area Founded in 2020 by a native Nevadan, The Biggest Little ATV Shop was created with one goal in mind - top-quality work without breaking the bank. We can help you with just about anything UTV and ATV related. Need some parts? No problem. Want to get your ride serviced to make sure it is running in tip-top shape? We offer same day general services. Want to separate your ride from everyone elses? We can customize and build you a one of a kind ATV or UTV. Services Top-quality Repairs for Your ATV at The Biggest Little ATV Shop Maintenance We recommend that your ATV or UTV be serviced at least once a year. This includes but is not limited to engine oil changes, transmission oil changes, differential oil changes, air filter service, spark plugs and a general inspection to see if anything else needs attention. Repairs When you're using your ATV or UTV the way they were meant to be used, things are bound to break. We can fix it all including suspension issues, engine issues, electrical issues, and more! Upgrades Want to upgrade your ride? We can do it all including suspension, lighting, wheels, tires, roll cages, and so much more. If you can envision it, we can make it happen! Why work with us Outstanding ATV Repair Service Fast Turnaround Time We understand that you may need your ride back as soon as possible for your big hunt, or to continue adentures with your family. We will ensure that your ride is done as soon as possible, without sacraficing quality! Expertise in All Major Brands At The Biggest Little ATV Shop, we work on all name brand ATVs and UTVs including Polaris, Can-Am, Honda, Yamaha and Kawasaki. Affordable Prices We believe that quality ATV repairs shouldn't break the bank. The Biggest Little ATV Shop offers competitive and transparent pricing for all our services. We provide accurate upfront quotes and strive to keep our rates affordable without compromising on the quality of our work. Trust us to deliver top-notch ATV repairs at a price that won't make your wallet cringe. Testimonials Happy Customers Share Their Experiences I've had Tyler work on my last two Polaris Buggy's and have to say he's always been honest, fair and reasonable with everything he done. I've recommended him to my friends and will recommend him to you. He's saved us a lot of $$$ over the years for diagnosing and fixing the problem in a timely manner. - Tony L. I brought my 22' Talon in to Tyler to add a new bumper, a winch, a sound bar, a new roof and a couple lights. I had a plan in my head of how I wanted it and the parts I wanted were ordered. Unfortunately, not everything fit the way wanted. Tyler was very helpful coming up with alternatives for the project. With his ideas, it turned out better than my original vision. Tyler does a super neat and clean install and left my machine looking like the work was done at the factory. Very responsive, even after hours. He ran every thing by me before he made any changes. I highly recommend Tyler and his shop for any of your ATV/UTV needs. - Chris F. I called a local ATV dealer to get some service done on my 1998 Yamaha Grizzly and was told they didn’t service old machines. I was lucky yo find Tyler he worked tirelessly to get it up and running. It hasn’t run that good in years. Tyler was able to trouble shoot some difficult electric issues and wouldn’t stop until everything was perfect. He also prefers to source US manufactured parts. A win win. I won’t be taking my ATV for service anywhere else. - John G. Contact Request a Quote Today We are here to help. Simply fill out our form and we'll get back to you with a personalized quote. In Partnership with MAKING MAGIC WITH DIRT! The Truckee Bike Park is located in beautiful Truckee, CA. The Park has the sweetest flow lines and the smoothest strider/pump track for all skill levels to progress. Along with beginner to advanced jump lines. The Park has something fun for everyone. ​ ​ Open to the public from sunrise to sunset (weather permitting), seven days a week during the summer months. Upon arriving at the park please take the time to read and respect the rules. ​ Closed The Park is Currently Thank you for a great 2025 season! We'll see you in 2026! ​ Check out our social media for the most up-to-date conditions when opening day approaches. NO HELMET NO BRAKES NO RIDE! PARK FEATURES & TRAILS Pump Tracks, Dirt Jumps, Flow Lines, Dual Slalom Track, XC Trail, Drop Zone, Slopestyle and more! From beginner to expert, there is something at the park for everyone CHECK 'EM OUT NEXT LEVEL BIKE COACHING Come out and become a better rider with help from our Bike Park certified coaches! All ages can learn new skills with our kids summer camp, one-on-one coaching, or with a group of friends and family. ​ LEARN MORE VOLUNTEER & DONATE The Park strives to be a world class cycling destination. However, this is not possible without your help. Volunteer your time or make a donation to help keep the park open and looking great! DO YOUR PART PRIVATE & GROUP BIKE COACHIN G Come out and become a better rider with help from our Bike Park certified coaches with the focus of one-on-one coaching or in a group alongside your friends and family! Private and group coaching is available from beginner to advanced skill levels and can focus on any type of skill you would like to progress. From biking fundamentals such as proper bike handling and cornering all the way up to hitting the big lines. Expand your skills to ride lines previously out of your ability level. LEARN MORE FULL BIKE SHOP Check out our new bike shop, right here at the park! We have dirt jumpers available to rent or buy. Full selection of parts and TBP merch. ​ Break something while riding at the park? We have a repair section as well to get you back on the trails! LEARN MORE Support the Park & Look Good Doing It! Tons of gear for Men, Women & Children! Choose from branded Truckee Bike Park Hats, Hoodies, Jackets, T-shirts, Tanks, and Swag. There's sure to be something for everyone! Every purchase is a donation, with the profits going right back into the park. SHOP MERCH OUR STORY The Truckee Bike Park was founded by Brooks Mcmullin and Cortney Knudson , two individuals with the dream of bringing a progressive trail system to the town of Truckee. The two of them have taken on the attitude of "Whatever it Takes" and have worked on this bike park every day since 2010 volunteering in every aspect, project managing, raising all the funds, digging, and hiring professional trail builders to bring you this amazing park you are experiencing today. Brooks and Cortney have collaborated with professional builders making the trails creative, progressive, and fun for all levels of riders. The park has been built with individual donations, grants, and fundraising efforts through the non-profit "Biking for a Better World" and has been FREE FOR YOU TO RIDE since its opening in July, 2011. Every dollar donated goes straight back into the park for you, your family, and for all of OUR friends to enjoy as well as progress our skills. ​ EASY DONATION We made it easy to donate to the park! Scan the QR code or click below to go to our Venmo account. DONATE Trail Map From easy rolling greens, to overhead double blacks, we have a trail for everyone. Explore what the park has to offer! pages.text: Truckee River Raft Company | Lake Tahoe Rafting on Truckee River Skip to primary navigation Skip to content Skip to footer Home Rafting on the Truckee River FAQ Gift Cards Buy Pictures Jobs Contact More Open More Menu Menu TRUCKEE RIVER RAFT COMPANY The Best River Rafting Adventure in Tahoe Book Now 2026 Bookings Open! Memorial Weekend (May 22nd) through Labor Day (September 7th)! River Rafting on the Truckee River in Tahoe City 2–3 Hours • Adults: $77 • Children: $40 This leisurely raft ride takes you five miles down the beautiful Truckee River! Enjoy the amazing scenery and feel free to pack a lunch and drinks. Book Now RAFT THE TRUCKEE RIVER The Original Lake Tahoe Rafting Outfitter We’re located on River Road/Highway 89 in the heart of Tahoe City, California less than 60 minutes south of Reno. Our signature raft excursions consist of a leisurely, self-guided, five-mile float down the Truckee River. Get ready to cruise through serene waters featuring picturesque mountain views and lively little rapids, punctuated here and there by swimming holes and sand bars. Boasting nothing more than a gentle Class I ripple, this Truckee River rafting journey is perfect for guests of all ages (2+) and experience levels. Soak in the sun and trail your fingers through these tranquil waters that can be navigated by almost any kind of boat, from kayaks to inflatable rafts. Take a break at one of the many picnic spots along the banks or take a swim in the river’s refreshing swimming holes. We happily welcome dogs and encourage you to bring lunch and drinks (please no Styrofoam or glass!) . We’re the ONLY rafting concession that exits directly onto the River Ranch Patio, where you can enjoy a delicious outdoor lunch after your river float. We also have an onsite convenience store where you can purchase essentials you may need for your trip, including (but not limited to) snacks, beverages (including beer), and sunscreen. This relaxing adventure takes 2-3 hours to complete. We have convenient parking right on site and door-to-door service. Not only does our friendly staff put you in a boat to start your adventure, but at the end of the day, they help you exit your boat, retrieve all your belongings, and ensure you have a great rest of your day. Where to Find Us We have a large parking lot across from the River Ranch called Hidden Valley. All Rafters must park at the Hidden Valley parking lot. Our Truckee River Raft Company Shuttle Bus will take you to the launch site and bring you back to your vehicle once your float concludes. Our shuttle bus serves patrons from 8:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. All of our trips Include: Free parking, shuttle bus, paddles, and life jackets for rafters 2 years and older. All rafts are large, sturdy, commercial white water grade rafts. Please park at our Hidden Valley parking lot, 2200 River Rd. Once parked we will check you in, have you sign your paperwork and put you on a shuttle to the launch site. After your trip a shuttle will be waiting at the River Ranch Lodge to return you to your vehicle. Book Now ❮ ❯ About Truckee River Rafting Truckee River Rafting is a family-owned business that has been operating since 1973. We offer self-guided rafting trips down the beautiful Truckee River, with commercial-grade rafts available for groups of all sizes. Your adventure begins in Tahoe City and floats through scenic meadows, mountain views, and gentle rapids, ending at the iconic River Ranch Restaurant. The trip takes about 2-3 hours and is fun for all ages (2 and up). Feel free to bring a soft cooler with snacks and drinks to enjoy along the way-but please, no styrofoam or glass. Your rafting trip includes free parking and shuttle transportation back to your car when your float is over, making the whole experience easy, relaxing, and memorable for all. Come join us for a day of fun on the river! Riverman Season Update We have now opened reservations for the 2026 season! Live River Web Cam! Check Today's Truckee River Flow Levels! Riverman's Opinion: 200 CFS- Low and Slow 300 CFS- Perfect 400 CFS- Swift Our Instagram Feed Testimonials Family Fun “Great rafting trip! Well organized from start to finish. Had lots of family fun! Mostly a lazy river, but some fun little rapids and great rapids for a grand finale. Good times!” - Nancy N. Best Way to Spend A Sunny Day “From the first moment we entered the parking lot, we were treated to top notch customer service by every staff member we encountered. Parking was easy, restrooms were clean, and we were on the water within minutes of our arrival. Go early to enjoy a relaxing float down the river. Pack beverages and snacks so you can stop for a picnic. This is a perfect activity for the whole family. Kudos for a well-run operation. Worth every penny. We'll be back” - Brigitte S. Unforgettable Experience “Awesome experience you will never forget. This is a must do in Tahoe. The family story is amazing and the river is truly gorgeous.” - Ray C. A Trip To Remember “Absolutely a must-do trip! The staff is friendly and helpful. The river is beautiful and crystal-clear. This trip is for any age group, and guaranteed to be one you'll always remember” - Linda D. Best Thing in Tahoe City “When visiting in Tahoe during the summer, there is one thing you have to do and that is rafting down the Truckee with Truckee River Rafting (Yellow Paddles). I have been doing this every year for 30+ years and we don't miss it. It is the most relaxing and serene trip. Go early when it's not crowded and you won't be disappointed” - Patty F A Family Tradition! “We have been rafting the Truckee with Truckee River Rafting for over 25 years! We have always had a great time and love the service they provide! I grew up rafting here with my parents and this was my first time bringing our son to do the same. Thanks for a great time!” - Cullen D. A Must Do! “What a BLAST! We had a great time and an awesome experience. The staff was awesome, well organized, friendly, and helpful! We loved that our dogs were able to accompany us on our rafting adventure. Rafts looked to be brand new and the process to book online was simple. We will definitely be back to enjoy this experience again. It was well worth the price. Thanks, Truckee River Rafting!” - Greg B. Great Family Fun! “Our family is a river rafting novice and this was a great experience for us. Fun for all! The river is slow with only a couple of minor "rapids" to navigate. There are many places to stop and enjoy lunch or a dip in the water. Also, the check in and out process with this company was super easy! Fabulous experience!” - Ryan P. Well Run Fun “My family and I had a great time! The process of getting people set up and in rafts was so smooth. From providing parking, easy and fast shuttle services to the actual float and instructions in case of any issues, this company is excellent.” - Michelle S. ❮ ❯ Navigation Home Prices Reservations Directions Riverman Says Cancellation Policy Contact Us Contact Us 175 River Road Tahoe City, CA 96145 (530) 583-1111 truckeeriverrafting@gmail.com Book a Reservation Book Now Follow Us Instagram Facebook Yelp Trip Advisor Copyright © 2026 TRR. Read More WHICH RENTAL PACKAGE IS RIGHT FOR YOU? , opens in a new window Ski & Snowboard FAQ RESERVATIONS & CANCELLATIONS Where do I make a reservation? You can make a reservation online through Epic Mountain Rentals or directly through participating resort rental pages. Booking online is the easiest way to browse available gear options, select your preferred package, and secure your reservation in advance. Booking online in advance helps ensure availability, faster pickup, and access to any applicable discounts. How far in advance do I need to book my reservation? You can book your reservation at any time before your arrival, but we recommend reserving at least a few days in advance to ensure the best selection and availability. If you make a reservation less than 2 calendar days in advance of your arrival, gear will only be available for pick up at a store location and delivery will not be available. Gear selection is subject to gear availability at time of booking. We recommend booking gear for a minimum of 48 hours in advance to ensure the best overall experience and selection. What is your refund policy? Full refunds are available if canceled at least 24 hours in advance by calling us at 970-754-0033 or toll free at 1-800-200-9990. For cancellations inside of 24 hours that have not yet been fulfilled, refunds are available minus a restocking fee by calling us at 970-754-0033. Restocking fees are applicable to each package on the reservation. No shows are non-refundable. What if I return my skis early? You'll be refunded for unused full days minus a restocking fee. Returns after 9 AM are charged for that day. Who can I contact for help with a reservation? We can be contacted at 970-754-0033 or toll free at 1-800-200-9990. What if I need to cancel or change my reservation? Reservations may be canceled up to 24 hours before 8:00 am local time on the first day of your reservation for a full refund, and can be done online. For cancellations inside of 24 hours that have not yet been fulfilled, refunds are available minus a restocking fee. Restocking fees are applicable to each package on the reservation. No shows are non-refundable. Please call 970-754-0033 (or toll free at 1-800-200-9990) so we can assist you. We cannot cancel reservations by email or in person. Rescheduled reservations will be subject to inventory available of their new date, which may be different from your original reservation. How do I determine my skier type? Your skier type reflects your ability level and is typically classified as Type I (Beginner), Type II (Intermediate), or Type III (Advanced). It helps rental shops and technicians set your equipment correctly for safety and performance. Bike Rentals FAQ What is your refund policy? You can cancel up to 24 hours before your reservation for a full refund. Call us to make a change at 970-754-0033 for U.S. reservations or 800-766-0449 for Canadian reservations. If you can, have your confirmation number handy. Can I change my rental dates after I book? Yes. We understand plans change. We're happy to modify your reservation up to 24 hours in advance. Call us to make a change at 970-754-0033 for U.S. reservations or 800-766-0449 for Canadian reservations. If you can, have your confirmation number handy. Do you rent helmets? Absolutely. For your safety, all rentals include a helmet. We have adult and kids sizes available for every bike rental. What should I wear? We recommend wearing layers you can remove as needed and packing rain gear or wind protection. Consider bringing a backpack to store any extra items and a water bottle if you're cruising around town. Do you rent kids' bikes? Most locations have kids bikes available; sizes may be limited. What time can I pick up my half-day morning rental? Generally, half-day morning rentals are 10 AM 2 PM. This can vary by location, so confirm the exact times with your rental shop. What time can I pick up my half-day afternoon rental? Generally, half-day afternoon rentals are 2 PM 6 PM. This can vary by location, so confirm the exact times with your rental shop. Do you rent protective gear aside from helmets? Yes, for certain bike park and downhill bike rentals. These options include knee and elbow pads and body armor and can be selected in Step 3. Are there mountain bike trails for beginners? Most locations have mountain bike trails for beginners. Ask a team member for their trail recommendations based on your experience and comfort level. What happens if I get a flat tire? Safety first. Dismount and move your bike to a safe place. Then, call the rental shop. We'll help fix your flat and get you back out there. We recommend bringing a cell phone and adding the shop's number before you begin your ride. What times of the year do you rent bikes? Typically, May through August, but this can vary by weather conditions and resort. For your safety, some trails may be closed early in the season. Can we bike on the ski resort property? At most resorts, yes. Check current conditions and for any trail restrictions before your visit. Several resorts also have chairlifts that carry you and your bike up the mountain so you can ride down single-track trails or ski runs. Resorts like Whistler Blackcomb, Keystone, Northstar and more have bike parks. My child is coming with a group, but I will not accompany him or her. Is there a liability waiver I need to sign? We require a parent or legal guardian to sign a release of liability on behalf of an unaccompanied person younger than 18 years old. Download, complete and print this waiver and send it with your child. They will not be able to participate if the release is not signed. No exceptions. Are there weight limits on your bikes? Yes, each manufacturer will set a maximum rider weight to ensure the safety of riders please contact your preferred rental store directly to confirm the maximum rider weight for the bike you're interested in renting. RESERVE YOUR BIKE RENTAL Know Before you ride guide WHAT YOU WILL FIND IN THIS GUIDE: Choosing the Right Bike for You Picking a Bike Route Trail Rules & Etiquette Bike Trip Essentials Things to Know How to choose the right bike for you: electric bike vs. traditional cruiser When planning your ride along Tahoe’s East Shore Trail (often referred to as “America’s Most Beautiful Bikeway”), it’s important to pick the bike rental that best fits your needs. An electric bike can be a great way to enjoy Lake Tahoe’s most spectacular and scenic ride without over exerting yourself. Spend your time soaking in all the views and not catching your breath. If you’re looking to get your heart rate up and experience more of a workout, a traditional cruiser would be an excellent choice. What’s an Electric Bike? The biggest difference between e-bikes and traditional cruisers is that e-bikes have motors. Our electric bikes are simple to use and understand. You ride and operate them just like you would with a traditional bike, except for 2 buttons that allow you to adjust how easy you want the pedaling to be with the help of the bike’s motor. For example, just press a button to adjust the pedal assistance on hills so you don’t have to over exert yourself. Our e-bike rentals are the most popular choice among riders. Experience the hype for yourself! What’s a Traditional Cruiser? A traditional cruiser is bike powered by the person riding it, with no assistance from an electrical motor. Our traditional cruiser rentals are 7-speed comfort bikes that are easy and simple to use for anyone who’s already comfortable riding a bike. Although they’re easy to ride, you can expect more of a workout (especially on hills) while riding a traditional cruiser than you would with an electric bike. For more details about the differences between these bike types, check out our Electric Bike Vs. Regular Bike blog post. Picking a Bike Route All our bikes (traditional and electric) are cruiser style bikes designed specifically for the Tahoe East Shore Trail, which is a paved path. If you’re looking to ride on a non-paved path, we recommend renting a mountain bike from another local bike shop. Where Can you Ride E-Bikes in Lake Tahoe? On the North end of Lake Tahoe, the most popular and scenic ride by far is the Tahoe East Shore Trail . This trail is often referred to as “America’s Most Beautiful Bikeway.” It’s paved and a good distance away from traffic. E-Bikes are allowed and encouraged on this trail. In the Lake Tahoe Basin, other trails that allow E-bikes include: Upper Corral, Lower Corral, Incense Cedar, Sidewinder, High Meadow OHV, Stinger, Beaver Tail Trail, Flume Trail, Tahoe Rim Trail (Hobart Rd to Tunnel Creek Rd only), Sand Pit 12N28, and all fire roads that allow motorized vehicles. Best Activities Along the East Shore Trail There are several free public beaches that are accessible from the trail. The most notable is Hidden Beach – a popular local destination. Sand Harbor State Park is at the end of the trail and features spectacular sandy beaches with tranquil turquoise coves. Beautiful walking paths can also be found here as well as a gift shop and a seasonal restaurant. Tunnel Creek Cafe is at the midpoint of the trail and is another local favorite for those looking for somewhere to eat along the way. The famous Monkey Rock Hike is also at the midway point of the trail for those who would like to get off and do a short and scenic hike (about 2 miles round trip). Best Places To Go Snowshoeing in Lake Tahoe - Vista Trail Bikes Skip to content 1 (775) 298-7431 rides@vistatrailbikes.com Bike Rentals East Shore Trail FAQs Blog Contact About Employment Bike Sale Bike Rentals East Shore Trail FAQs Blog Contact About Employment Bike Sale BOOK NOW Bike Rentals East Shore Trail FAQs Blog Contact About Employment Bike Sale Bike Rentals East Shore Trail FAQs Blog Contact About Employment Bike Sale December 22, 2023 The Ultimate Guide: Top 6 Places To Go Snowshoeing in Lake Tahoe By Ted Schlater Looking for the best snowshoeing in Lake Tahoe? Look no further than this guide for the best spots recommended by locals. Winter in Lake Tahoe starts around November and brings with it endless winter activities. From skiing to snowmobiling, this picturesque destination has something to do for everyone. Not only is there an average of 600 inches of snow each winter, there’s also 300 days of sunshine on average each year. This is why Tahoe is such a popular winter destination! Given the popularity of sports like skiing and snowboarding, snowshoeing may seem like an unlikely choice. However, read on to learn about all the reasons why this activity is a great option for everyone. Table of Contents Why Snowshoeing? Fewer People: Unlike the more popular activities, Lake Tahoe snowshoe trails are relatively less crowded. You can enjoy the scenery around you without having to worry about bumping into too many people. Beautiful Scenery: Lake Tahoe is famous for its gorgeous views, and snowshoeing is the perfect way to appreciate them in the winter. You can snowshoe at your own pace and skill level as you take in the winter wonderland around you. Accessibility: Snowshoeing is generally a low-impact activity, making it accessible for people of all ages and fitness levels. Additionally, there’s a wide range of Lake Tahoe snowshoe trails of varying difficulty levels. And because snowshoeing is accessible for people of all ages, it’s a great way for families to spend time together in the winter and get in some exercise at the same time! Winter Photography: Snowshoeing in Lake Tahoe is an easy activity for stopping along the way to take pictures of the stunning winter views. You’ll see snow-capped mountains, frozen waterfalls, and more. If you’re lucky, you may even be able to capture some winter wildlife, like deer, rabbits, and birds! Adventure: Snowshoeing gives you a chance to explore areas of Lake Tahoe that may not be accessible in the summer months. With snowshoes on your feet, you’ll be able to walk through hidden trails, explore the woods, and climb small hills. Cardiovascular Exercise: If you’re looking for a great way to workout without too much exertion, snowshoeing is a perfect activity. Given that it’s a low-impact form of exercise, you’re not putting too much pressure on your body while also working your legs and core and burning calories at the same time. Convenience: Snowshoes are easy to store, transport, and take on and off, thus giving you the flexibility to explore on your own terms and schedule. And if you’re trying snowshoeing for the first time, you can always rent snowshoeing equipment for a relatively low cost until you know if you like it. We offer snowshoe rentals at Vista Trail Bikes. Snowshoe Rentals Now that you know the benefits of snowshoeing in Lake Tahoe, you may be wondering where you can enjoy this pastime. Here are some of the best Lake Tahoe snowshoe trails enjoyed by locals and visitors alike! 1. Tahoe Meadows Experience the best of Tahoe winter! Tahoe Meadows offers access to a wide variety of winter time activities such as sledding, snowmobiling, backcountry skiing, and snowshoeing. Nevada Nordic – a community based organization whose mission it is to promote the establishment of a multi-use venue – periodically grooms a wide selection of trails (see map) for backcountry skiing, fat tire biking and snowshoeing. The variety of trails means there’s something for everyone at any skill level. There’s usually plenty of parking and it’s a popular and easily accessible destination for families visiting Tahoe in the winter. If you’re able to, remember to kindly donate to Nevada Nordic using the QR codes found on the signage you encounter along your adventure. 2. Mount Peak Rose Trail Distance: 10.7 miles (17.2 km) Elevation Gain: 2,378 ft Difficulty: Challenging, best for experienced hikers Mount Rose is the third tallest mountain peak in the Tahoe basin and is perfect for more experienced hikers looking for a snowshoeing trail to explore. There are several smaller trails, including Tahoe Meadows and Chickadee Ridge . The Mount Rose Peak Trail is longer (10.7 mile loop) but can still be enjoyed on snowshoes if you’re up for the challenge! This trail boasts some incredible scenery, including waterfalls and forested areas. You can also take in the sights of some of the other peaks in Lake Tahoe, including Tamarack Peak . At the top of the Mount Rose Peak Trail, you’ll be able to enjoy stunning views of the entire Lake Tahoe basin. Similar to Fallen Leaf Lake Trail , this trail is also dog-friendly, so you can bring your pets with you. Just remember that they must always be kept on a leash. Though the elevation gain is significant, it’s also gradual, so you can adjust to the change as you climb. 3. Chickadee Ridge Distance: 3 miles (4.8 km) Elevation Gain: 400 ft Difficulty: Beginner-friendly, moderately challenging The Chickadee Ridge snowshoe hike starts at the Tahoe Meadows Trail and consists of a gentle climb along the ridge. The trailhead is easily accessible and is suitable for both beginners and more experienced snowshoers. This hike promises stunning Lake Tahoe views and is also the perfect place to spot some of Tahoe’s friendly chickadee birds, especially closer to spring. Once you spot the birds, you can sprinkle some bird seed in your open hand and they may actually eat out of your hands. This can be a wonderful photo opportunity! 4. Donner Peak Trail Distance : 4.7 miles (6 km) Elevation Gain: 905 ft Difficulty: Beginner-friendly, moderately challenging A relatively short out and back route, Donner Peak Trail has gorgeous views of Lake Tahoe and Donner Lake. Not only that, it’s great for beginners because it has a ton of places to rest along the way. This trail is an especially good beginner snowshoeing option if you’re staying in Truckee. It’s also a generally quiet trail, so you don’t have to worry about running into too many other people crowding up the trail. As an added benefit, this trail is dog friendly, so you can bring your pup along with you, as long as they are on a leash. 5. Fallen Leaf Lake Trail Distance: 3.5 miles (5.6 km) Elevation Level: 144 ft Difficulty: Beginner-friendly, moderately challenging The Fallen Leaf Lake Trail is one of the most beautiful trails in South Lake Tahoe. The views across this trail include waterfalls, wildflowers (in the spring and summer), conifer trees, as well as a gorgeous alpine lake, which is often frozen over in the winter. The trail is accessible year-round and both dog-friendly and beginner-friendly. You should be done in just over an hour, so you can easily bring your furry best friend with you when you go adventuring on this trail. 6. Van Sickle Rim Trail Connector Distance: 6.4 miles (10.3 km) Elevation Level: 1,351 ft Difficulty: Moderately challenging, good for beginners and experienced snowshoers alike The Van Sickle Rim Trail Connector is one of the most popular places to go snowshoeing in Lake Tahoe and for good reason. It’s an easily accessible trailhead with breathtaking views of alpine forests, snow-melt cascades, and more. There are also numerous rocky outcroppings where you can rest and take in all of Lake Tahoe’s splendor. This out-and-back trail is one of the most flexible trails you’ll find in Lake Tahoe. An electric bike can be a great way to enjoy Lake Tahoe’s most spectacular and scenic ride without over exerting yourself. Spend your time soaking in all the views and not catching your breath. If you’re looking to get your heart rate up and experience more of a workout, a traditional cruiser would be an excellent choice. What’s an Electric Bike? The biggest difference between e-bikes and traditional cruisers is that e-bikes have motors. Our electric bikes are simple to use and understand. You ride and operate them just like you would with a traditional bike, except for 2 buttons that allow you to adjust how easy you want the pedaling to be with the help of the bike’s motor. For example, just press a button to adjust the pedal assistance on hills so you don’t have to over exert yourself. Our e-bike rentals are the most popular choice among riders. Experience the hype for yourself! What’s a Traditional Cruiser? A traditional cruiser is bike powered by the person riding it, with no assistance from an electrical motor. Our traditional cruiser rentals are 7-speed comfort bikes that are easy and simple to use for anyone who’s already comfortable riding a bike. Although they’re easy to ride, you can expect more of a workout (especially on hills) while riding a traditional cruiser than you would with an electric bike. For more details about the differences between these bike types, check out our Electric Bike Vs. Regular Bike blog post. On the North end of Lake Tahoe, the most popular and scenic ride by far is the Tahoe East Shore Trail . This trail is often referred to as “America’s Most Beautiful Bikeway.” It’s paved and a good distance away from traffic. E-Bikes are allowed and encouraged on this trail. In the Lake Tahoe Basin, other trails that allow E-bikes include: Upper Corral, Lower Corral, Incense Cedar, Sidewinder, High Meadow OHV, Stinger, Beaver Tail Trail, Flume Trail, Tahoe Rim Trail (Hobart Rd to Tunnel Creek Rd only), Sand Pit 12N28, and all fire roads that allow motorized vehicles. Best Activities Along the East Shore Trail There are several free public beaches that are accessible from the trail. The most notable is Hidden Beach – a popular local destination. Sand Harbor State Park is at the end of the trail and features spectacular sandy beaches with tranquil turquoise coves. Beautiful walking paths can also be found here as well as a gift shop and a seasonal restaurant. Tunnel Creek Cafe is at the midpoint of the trail and is another local favorite for those looking for somewhere to eat along the way. The famous Monkey Rock Hike is also at the midway point of the trail for those who would like to get off and do a short and scenic hike (about 2 miles round trip). Your go-to for Lake Tahoe's most unforgettable water adventures. We offer clear kayak and paddleboard rentals in Kings Beach that let you experience the lake like never before. Glide over crystal-clear waters, soak in the sun, and connect with the wild beauty of Tahoe. Whether you're a first-timer or a seasoned paddler, we're here to help you float, explore, and fall in love with the lake all over again. We've lowered our rates like, really lowered them. A New Chapter for Wild Society After a decade in Kings Beach, Wild Society has temporarily paused operations while we search for our next home. ​ This wasn't a decision we planned to make, but we're incredibly grateful for every customer, sunrise paddle, proposal, anniversary, family vacation, and memory shared along the way. Read Our Story The Clearest Way to See Lake Tahoe What Happened? ​ Many of you have reached out asking where Wild Society went. After ten years at our longtime Kings Beach location, changes beyond our control forced us to leave the space we called home. ​ Wild Society was not sold, closed or retiring. ​ We are actively exploring what's next and hope this is simply the beginning of a new chapter. Until then, thank you for your patience, encouragement and support. Where Lake Tahoe's magic is crystal clear. Welcome to Wild Society.... Rooted in Tahoe. The clear kayak experience, authentically redefined. Let's Explore We've lowered our rates like, really lowered them . We've lowered our rates like, really lowered them. Life's been heavy lately, and we believe joy, adventure, and beautiful memories should always be within reach. We're not here to squeeze every penny or follow the crowd. We've felt the weight of these times too and we believe the little moments of magic matter more than ever. That's why we made the choice to lower our prices to make it easier for you to get back to the good stuff: the laughter, the sunshine, the feeling of floating free. Adventure belongs to all of us and we're so honored to be a small part of your story. Come drift, dream, and float into lighter days with us. ​ You deserve this. Our Adventures All Activities Take in all of Lake Tahoe's vast and picturesque landscape. With its crystal clear clarity, various shades of turquoise shores and gorgeous private coves and hidden beaches all over; there is no better way to take in the magical scenery than floating along in an entirely clear kayak or transparent paddleboard delivering crystal-clear views unlike any other. Come experience our clear kayak and transparent stand-up paddle board rentals and guided tours in North Lake Tahoe. It's an adventure you won't want to forget. Our clear kayaks each are equipped with wireless waterproof speakers with USB plug to play what you desire with your own personal device, waterproof phone cases that keep your phones dry and even allow you to take underwater photos, high-quality "dry bags", binoculars, a small cooler (upon request), selfie sticks and, of course, safety equipment needed to protect you in any situation. ​ This is a family-friendly activity and fun for all ages (well, not all; we do have a minimum age requirement of 5 years old for kiddos). Kayaks SUPs Tours At Remedy Eatery, we strive to simply nourish and inspire our community with healthy, soul-pleasing foods, bold, complex flavors and the freshest of ingredients. With magic found in every whimsical bite, we are dedicated to sharing creative food experiences that surprise the palette and have you reaching for more. At Remedy Eatery, we offer more than just healthy food. We have created an atmosphere that is perfect for dining, whether you are looking to relax alone or catch up with friends over a meal. Our restaurant offers plenty of seating both indoors and outdoors, so you can enjoy your meal in a comfortable and inviting atmosphere. And with free WiFi available, you can easily stay connected while you dine. We strive to create an unparalleled dining experience that will keep you coming back for more, so if you are looking for somewhere to eat in North Lake Tahoe, come dine with us and see why we are a beloved destination for health food in the area. Our Eatery Dine With Us Salads and Bowls Wraps and Toasts Tonics & Elixirs Remedy Hour "Best day we had!" We did the 4 hour rental and had a blast. A few us did the clear kayaks and the others did the clear paddle boards. We went kayaking around Kings Beach and over to the coves in Crystal Bay we were told about and they did not disappoint! It was absolutely beautiful and so much fun. It was the best day we had in Lake Tahoe! "Perfect location" We had an incredible time renting the clear bottom kayaks from Wild Society. They are in the perfect location for a paddle to see the beautiful clear waters of Tahoe! I would definitely recommend this excursion! "Too much fun!!" The rental was smooth and the water was even smoother. It was a glassy morning on Lake Tahoe and it was the coolest experience being in a glass bottom boat. The staff knew their stuff, the location is perfect and away from the craziness and the whole adventure was just too much fun!! Gallery Get Inspired With Our Exclusive Views With North Lake Tahoe roots and years of refining the clear kayak experience, Wild Society continues to redefine what a perfect Tahoe adventure can be. Meet the heart behind Wild Society. View All Photos Wild Society offers clear kayak and clear paddleboard rentals that highlight Lake Tahoe's clarity and natural beauty. Our experiences are designed for visitors looking for a relaxed, scenic way to spend time on the lake. Our clear kayak and SUP rentals in Kings Beach are perfect for solo travelers, couples, and groups looking for a unique Lake Tahoe experience. Includes everything in Tier 1, plus a waterproof Bluetooth speaker, goggles, binoculars and Wild Upgrade Tier 2 Built for families who want everyone engaged, entertained and off their screens. Family Fun Pack For Your Favorite Adventure Partner; because the best lake days include them too. Memory Making Kit For the curious and always exploring; its just enough gear to keep them engaged from launch to shoreline. From comfort upgrades and adventure extras to take-home pieces and group add-ons, there are plenty of ways to make your day on the water even better. Explore Our Add-Ons Things to Know Before You Book Have questions about what to bring, where to go, or how it all works? Check out our FAQs before you paddle. Our Launch Spot We do not operate or deliver our equipment to Sand Harbor. Our photos/videos seen here on our website and various social media pages were all taken at some stunning, secluded coves a short distance from our launch location. It's our hidden gem equipped with its own smaller Bonsai Rock. You will still get to experience that stunning turquoise water and large boulders you desire (without all the craziness and crowds you experience at Sand Harbor & surrounding areas)! Recommended Rental Times At least a 2 hour rental is recommended to get over to the area we suggest and the 3 & 4 hour options give you plenty of time to reach a very beautiful cove only accessible by watercraft (HIGHLY recommended). ​ PLEASE NOTE: Our 1-hour rentals do not give you much time to explore outside of the public beach area surrounding our launch location. If you are hoping to reach the very secluded coves with bright turquoise waters, you will need to book a longer rental. However, Lake Tahoe is pretty much entirely turquoise no matter where you explore, so you will still get to experience the stunning waters during this rental, but timing is limited to venture off very far. Kayak Weight Limits Our single and double kayaks are the same. We simply remove a seat to accommodate a single rental. 2 persons MAX for doubles. We will not accommodate 3 persons in one kayak (even if it's 2 adults & 1 child). ​ Weight limit of the kayaks is 275lbs. The SUPs have a weight limit of 350lbs. Discount Reminders *Discounts cannot be applied after completing your reservation. We cannot go back and make adjustments to payments when forgetting to include promo code when checking out. If you forget, you can save it for a future rental. We hope you have so much fun that you want to come back (or maybe share the experience with a friend). Wild Society offers clear kayak rentals in Lake Tahoe, giving you the chance to paddle across crystal-clear water while seeing directly into the lake below. Our clear kayaks are self-guided, beginner-friendly and available seasonally May through October. This experience is especially popular with couples, families, first-time kayakers, and visitors looking for a scenic and memorable summer activity in North Lake Tahoe. At a Glance A clear kayak is made from durable, transparent material that allows you to see straight through the entirety of the boat into the water below. In Lake Tahoe, clear kayaks offer a unique way to experience the lake's famous clarity, rocky shoreline, and shifting shades of blue while enjoying a calm, easy paddle on the surface. What Is a Clear Kayak? All clear kayak rentals with Wild Society are self-guided. Before launching, you'll receive a brief orientation to help you feel comfortable on the water. Learn More about Marina Learn More - Zephyr Cove Marina Experience Additional Information Boating Safety Pets Parking The Nevada boating safety education certificate (commonly known as a Nevada boating license) is proof that a boater has successfully completed a boating safety course. All persons who operate vessels powered by a motor over 15 horsepower on interstate waters and who were born on or after January 1, 1983, must possess a certificate of completion of a boater education course or proficiency exam. (Interstate waters mean waters forming the boundary between the State of Nevada and an adjoining state.) The course or exam must be one that is approved by the Nevada Department of Wildlife. The Boat Nevada course meets these requirements and is the same course taught in Nevada classrooms. Even if not required by law to get the Nevada boating license, many boaters take the boat safety course in order to save on their PWC or boat insurance. overnight at Zephyr Cove Marina's convenient buoy rentals. Located in the heart of Zephyr Cove Resort, you'll enjoy easy access to a mile-long sandy beach, dining at the Sunset Bar & Grille, a full-service restaurant, coffee bar, and shopping. Stay close to the action and the breathtaking beauty of Lake Tahoe! Short-term Buoy Rentals To request guest mooring, please call 775.589.4901 . Availability is limited, and reservations are required for short-term buoy rentals. The rental fee includes shuttle service to your mooring between 10:00 AM and 6:00 PM during summer, as well as a daily vehicle parking pass. For questions, call Zephyr Cove Marina office at 775.589.4901 . NOTE: No overnight camping is allowed on any boat moored at Zephyr Cove Marina. Boat Launch Ramps Boats may not be launched at Zephyr Cove Marina. Launching is available at Cave Rock, operated by Nevada State Parks, located 3 miles north of Zephyr Cove. The launch fee is $20.00 for Nevada residents and $25.00 for non-residents. Invasive mussel inspection fees apply, and overnight trailer storage is not available. overnight at Zephyr Cove Marina's convenient buoy rentals. Located in the heart of Zephyr Cove Resort, you'll enjoy easy access to a mile-long sandy beach, dining at the Sunset Bar & Grille, a full-service restaurant, coffee bar, and shopping. Stay close to the action and the breathtaking beauty of Lake Tahoe! Short-term Buoy Rentals To request guest mooring, please call 775.589.4901 . Availability is limited, and reservations are required for short-term buoy rentals. The rental fee includes shuttle service to your mooring between 10:00 AM and 6:00 PM during summer, as well as a daily vehicle parking pass. For questions, call Zephyr Cove Marina office at 775.589.4901 . NOTE: No overnight camping is allowed on any boat moored at Zephyr Cove Marina. Boat Launch Ramps Boats may not be launched at Zephyr Cove Marina. Launching is available at Cave Rock, operated by Nevada State Parks, located 3 miles north of Zephyr Cove. The launch fee is $20.00 for Nevada residents and $25.00 for non-residents. Invasive mussel inspection fees apply, and overnight trailer storage is not available. Tucked away on the serene north shore of Lake Tahoe, Crystal Bay with its Speedboat Beach, is the perfect home base for a daylong boat excursion. But with convenient access to hidden coves, historic sites and waterfront dining, it’s a great place to rent a boat for the day and play without the crowds or havoc of neighboring towns. Crystal Bay Boat Rentals & Charters Tahoe Bliss Boat Charters offers captained boat rentals of all sizes, including wake‑surf boats, powerboats, and pontoons — ideal for families, thrill fishermen, or sunset seekers. Choose from optional add‑ons including wake surfing, tubing, waterskiing, fireworks watching, full‑moon or star gazing voyages, and flexible sunset cruises. Best Day‑Trip Routes from Crystal Bay Crystal Bay & Speedboat Beach offer some of the most stunning views in all of Lake Tahoe. Below are some of our favorite places to check out when you are out enjoying you Lake Tahoe boat rental: Cruise Along North Shore Speedboat Beach cove: Anchor here to swim, paddleboard, and sunbathe Secluded coves & boulder strewn beaches: Hideaway vistas for photos and tranquility Sightseeing & History Cal-Neva Lodge & Casino: See the iconic lakefront resort (Frank Sinatra’s summer go-to) from the water Tahoe Biltmore site: Grab a peek at the former casino site at the water’s edge Withers Log House & Cal-Vada Lodge: Historic log architecture in Crystal Bay Sunsets, Moonlight & Fireworks Cruises Sure‑to‑wow sunset charters from 7–9pm Moonlit stargazing excursions, with a brilliant Milky Way above Tahoe’s dark-sky vantage point Enjoy the 4th of July or Labor Day straight from your boat - fireworks in your front yard! What to Do After Boating in Crystal Bay with Tahoe Bliss Boat Charters On‑Shore Stops & Dining Although boats can be moored anywhere, here are a few of the destination shore-side spots to add to your boating itinerary: Cal-Neva Resort: Tie up or drop anchor just off shore and make a short lakeside visit inside the historic lodge and casino. Crystal Bay Club: Lake view, lakeside dining, and setting right on the water. Cal-Neva Lodge: Classic cabin charm just out the door on the water. Activities Beyond Boating in Crystal Bay Enjoy some more water-filled fun throughout the day: Kayaking / SUP tours: Launch from Speedboat Beach, walk to the beach front shop with easy rentals, and return tothe beach for calm water shoreline paddles Fishing charters: Top-rated guides such as Sierra Fin Addicts and Lake Tahoe Luxury Boat Rentals are based in these parts What to Bring & Know Before You Come Must Haves: Sunscreen, towels, suits, warm clothes, water & snacks, waterproof phone case Book early: Summer weekends fill up quickly—get your boat charter locked in early Captain included: All rentals come with USCG‑certified captains for your safety and convenience Crystal Bay Fun Facts & Local History Withers Log House (1931)and Cal-Vada Lodge (1935) are both listed on the National Register of Historic Places, reminders of Crystal Bay's early period of rustic resorts. The new lodge, the Cal-Neva Lodge, had been built just 30 days after fire turned an older hostelry of the same name to ashes, and it became well known in the 1960s when it was owned by Frank Sinatra. A bona fide North Shore jewel, Hidden Beach provides the clear blue waters, sun-warmed granite boulders and low-key, mellow vibe that makes it seem miles away from the crowded public hoopla of many beach outings. Whether you're seeking a romantic getaway, family fun, or a serene day of beachside relaxation, there is nothing like experiencing the beauty of this secluded shoreline with a Hidden Beach boat rental from Tahoe Bliss Boat Charters. Why Hidden Beach for Lake Tahoe Boating? Hidden Beach certainly earns its name. You can reach this crescent cove by water or a short walk along the East Shore Trail, and it slides away in the distance past smooth granite boulders, turquoise-blue shallows and pine-fringed cliffs. It's one of the few “locals only”-style spots, quiet, scenic, and often less crowded than some of Tahoe’s bigger beaches. At Tahoe Bliss, we like to take our guests to Hidden Beach because it’s so pretty and it’s well off the beaten path, with great swimming and snorkeling, and with a relaxed energy that's perfect for anchoring, sun bathing, or having a picnic on board. Our Hidden Beach boat rentals provide fully private, captained outings that empower you to experience Lake Tahoe the way you want to. We cruise from the pickup location of your choice (may possibly include Incline Village or Sand Harbor) directly to Hidden Beach in style. What to Expect: Cushionsuits and lots of shade Bluetooth speaker systems for all your favorite tunes Paddleboards, floats and Snorkeling gear provided Your own local, Coast Guard licensed captain at the helm to guide and tailor your day You’ll drop anchor just off shore, enjoy unimpeded views of the passing granite shoreline, float in the warmth of the sun and swim in some of the clearest water Tahoe has to offer. Things to Do at Hidden Beach Less developed than the expansive public beaches on the lake, Hidden Beach is why people love Tahoe. The following are some of our favorite things to do when visiting by boat: Swimming & Snorkeling The peaceful, pristine waters around Hidden Beach are perfect for swimming and snorkeling. You will frequently see trout and bass weaving between boulders, and there’s great underwater visibility in calm conditions. Sunbathing on the Boulders Sun-warmed granite boulders that rim the beach provide natural lounge chairs with sunset views. Reel in your float or climb out onto a rock and soak in the serenity. Picnic On Board Our boat rentals come with a cooler and a lot of room for snacks and drinks. Pack your own favorite local nibbles or let us arrange for you to coordinate with gourmet delis in the area for a more upscale lakeside picnic. Paddleboarding Because of the generally tranquil water, Hidden Beach is a paddleboarder’s dream. Whistle around the cove or explore little nooks and crannies of shoreline, or just float about and relax. Where to Eat Nearby Although there are no food vendors on Hidden Beach itself (that’s part of the charm!), there are more than a few wonderful options just a short drive or boat ride away: Lone Eagle Grille (Incline Village) Fine dining overlooking the lake, featuring seafood and upscale mountain fare. Tunnel Creek Café Perfect post-beach fare of fresh coffee, sandwiches and smoothies right at the trailhead of the East Shore Trail. T’s Mesquite Rotisserie Home of the massive burritos and tacos, this locals’ spot in Incline Village is great for takeout before or after boating. Alibi Ale Works (Incline Public House) Craft beer and high-end bar food to relax at after your boat day. How to Access Hidden Beach Access to Hidden Beach is two-fold. By Boat (Highly Recommended) The best way to visit Hidden Beach is catching it by water. With a Hidden Beach boat tour, no parking frustration, no crowds, and VIP treatment for this idyllic beach! By Foot For those on land, Hidden Beach is a short walk or bike off the East Shore Trail, a two-way paved path that connects Incline Village to Sand Harbor. Parking is minimal off Highway 28, and there’s a short walk to reach them. Insider Advice on Visiting Hidden Beach Stake out the best anchoring spots in advance, arriving early by boat, particularly on weekends. Bring what you need — there are no restrooms or services at the beach. Take water shoes if you want to wade in by the rocks. Mind the silence — Hidden Beach is a tranquil zone, not a party cove. We guarantee there is something for everyone to enjoy! To top it off, we include a video/photo package to capture your “Tahoe Experience” with 4K drone footage and 12MP camera stills. Share your adventure with friends online or simply keep for yourself to look back on for years to come. Book with us today and appreciate all that Lake Tahoe has to offer like a true local on The Tahoe Experience. We also have a full service launching & landing department equipped with a travel lift, fork lift, and launch ramp for your convenience. NOTE: All vessels being launched must be inspected prior to launching. Visit tahoeboatinspections.com for more information. SLIP INQUIRY FORM Wet Slips Under Redevelopment Tahoe Keys Marina stands as the premier maritime hub and the largest marina on Lake Tahoe, uniquely positioned as the lake’s only inland marina. This sheltered, inland configuration provides a fully protected harbor for your vessel, offering a calm and secure environment that is shielded from the wind and heavy chop of the open water. Our expansive 22-acre facility in South Lake Tahoe is engineered for comprehensive vessel care, featuring a full-service boat launch, a high-capacity Travel Lift, and a specialized Jib crane for sailboat stepping and service. As a complete destination for both boaters and mountain enthusiasts, our property offers high-speed diesel and regular fuel, a curated selection of local charter vendors, a professional on-site water ski school, and premier waterfront dining. DRY STORAGE Tahoe Keys Marina also provides dry storage solutions, offering secure trailer storage for vessels up to 60’ in length. Located in South Lake Tahoe, our dedicated storage lot is the ideal off-season or year-round home for larger boats and trailers, providing easy access to the water while ensuring your investment is kept safe in a professional marina environment. Whether you need a spot for a performance boat or a large cruiser, our Tahoe Keys dry storage facility offers the space and security required for the premier Lake Tahoe boating lifestyle. Tahoe Paradise Park News Click For Agenda & Board Packet Tahoe Paradise Recreation and Park District On the banks of the Upper Truckee River is one of Tahoe's little-known gems. Away from the crowds and traffic, Tahoe Paradise Park offers many outdoor activities and events. Lake Baron, the heart of the upper park area, provides great fishing spots and calm water for paddle boarding or kayaking and hosts lakefront weddings by the infamous 1000 year old Juniper Tree. Find your game at the Tennis courts or enjoy live music and events held at the Clubhouse with beach access. The lower park area, along the banks of the Upper Truckee River, holds the playground, disc golf course, and a large picnic area. Find numerous hiking and mountain biking trails throughout the park. Any of the upper or lower areas can be reserved for your wedding or event! The park is administered by the Tahoe Paradise Recreation & Park District. results.google_text: Tahoe Paradise Park Lakeshore recreation area for swimming, fishing & BBQs, plus farmers' markets & hiking trails. Park on the Upper Truckee River offering paddle-boating and kayaking on Lake Baron, plus picnic facilities. Visitors say this park offers a beautiful and peaceful natural setting with a clean lake, perfect for various outdoor activities like walking, fishing, and paddleboarding. They also highlight the availability of pickleball courts, a frisbee golf course, and a popular farmers market. results.google_text:
Drink Coffee Do Stuff Relaxed, modern, cabin-inspired shop for gourmet coffee drinks (hot or iced), bagels, pastries and toast. People say this coffee shop offers delicious coffee, unique seasonal lattes, and tasty food options like avocado toast and prosciutto sandwiches. Visitors also highlight the cozy atmosphere, friendly staff, and quick service, even during busy times.

Some reviews mention the service can be unprofessional. coffee_shop cafe food_store store food point_of_interest establishment

results.google_overview: Coffeebar Casual coffeehouse (part of a chain) serving espresso drinks and bakery treats, along with snacks and brunch fare.
results.google_text:
Coffeebar Casual coffeehouse (part of a chain) serving espresso drinks and bakery treats, along with snacks and brunch fare. Diners like this cafe's delicious coffee, freshly baked pastries, and healthy food options, including gluten-free choices. They also highlight the friendly staff, reasonable prices, and ample seating with a large patio.

Some reviews mention the service can be slow. coffee_shop snack_bar bakery meal_takeaway cafe food_store store restaurant food point_of_interest establishment

Electra Just Dreaming Bayliner Explore San Francisco New! ← " My partner and I really enjoyed this breathtaking experience of staying on a boat, it is in a beautiful location, near the city center of Key West. We were able to go on a charter and enjoy the beauty of the sea in the Keys, as well as snorkeling in reefs and fishing. I really recommend this boat! Clair · July 2024 We had the best time at Larry & Allie's cabin and felt right at home! We also went out on their chartered boat for the afternoon and it was the highlight of our trip! Definitely check out their company The Water Traveler! So fun! Sarah · July 2024 Captain ALi and her team were absolutely amazing to work with during our wedding weekend. They were the only vendor we could find that was willing and excited to help us put on a hybrid boat and beach event on the Lake. They went out of their way to make the event fun and personalized, from the activities available to the food and drinks to the decor, and to say they exceeded our expectations would be an understatement. They were by far the easiest and most fun vendor we worked with throughout our wedding weekend and the day-of execution was flawless. We could not be more thankful to Captain ALi and her entire team for going out of their way to make it so special for us. THANK YOU! Sudhish · 2022 Hugely fun day with the family on Lake Tahoe with every kind of water toy imaginable. Captain Ali and her crew made it all a blast and even got us beginners wake surfing. A huge bonus was not having to prepare for this at all. They gathered the toys, food, alcohol, towels, everything. We just showed up and had fun. Dee · 2022 I went out to Lake Tahoe for my bachelor party and we chartered two boats with Ali and her team. 18 of us, so we were a handful. They were unbelievable and amazing! Unforgettable experience. It was so much more than I could have hoped for. They not only took care of us as advertised but went way above and beyond. Captain Ali and her team were amazing and people would be crazy to not book with them. Seriously an amazing experience and I would recommend Tahoe Lake Love to everyone I know and everyone I don't. That's how awesome they are! Brent · 2023 Taking a private charter with Captain Ali was one of the best days we've ever had and 100% was money well spent. Captain Ali was amazing and fun and went above and beyond to make our experience a great one. We got to sight-see, play with all the fun water toys, and lounge by the beach, all without having to think about food or drinks or towels or sunscreen. Ali thought of everything! We will definitely do this again. Unforgettable! Lisa · 2023 Ali and her team helped create an amazing family trip to Lake Tahoe this summer. I have stayed at many properties with great hosts, but Ali and her team stand above the rest. Great and fast communication, stocked, clean, and amazing property, captained boat charter with all the amenities, beautiful location. My family gives Ali, boat charter crew, and Tahoe Lake Love our fullest recommendation! Brett · 2022 An absolute blast! We booked the boat charter with Captain Ali and Captain Larry for a bachelorette bash. They were so kind and communicative from beginning to end! We happened to be in Tahoe when it was an unseasonably cold weekend, but they did everything they could to ensure we had the best day weather wise and moved our charter to the middle of the day so we could all be warm. They also completely outdid themselves with hosting, great food, great drinks, and even party favors! I can't recommend this charter enough. Bring your friends and get ready for the best time you can have on Lake Tahoe. Ali and Larry are the bee's knees. I would 100% book again! Kandi · 2022 Ali, her property, and boat charter absolutely made my husband's 50th birthday an incredible experience. Hands down the best vacation rental property and boat charter one stop shop! Every detail was thought of, considered, and implemented to perfection. 100% will make this experience a yearly event! Julia · 2022 We stayed at a property and booked a lake charter with them last year and it was hands down the most memorable part of our entire summer break! The home was super comfortable, clean, and in an amazing location. It was an easy walk to the dock where Captain Ali picked us up. She thinks of literally EVERYTHING to make the day as fun and easy as possible! She stocked the boat with drinks, water, delicious food, sunscreen, and several water toys to keep everyone entertained. She took us to some gorgeous local spots for swimming, and patiently blew up and deflated the raft a million times for my little one. While the day couldn't have been more perfect, I can say without a doubt that Captain Ali is the magic that makes it work. We've booked again for this summer and none of us can wait to get back out on the lake. I wouldn't even consider booking a charter with anyone else, Captain Ali and Tahoe Lake Love is where it's at! Bigger Adventures Coming! Float Reno is taking a pause for the 2026 season as we are developing an exciting new experience and future improvements for Reno's river adventure community. Thank you for the incredible support we look forward to welcoming you back in Summer 2027. Check out the latest float conditions ↦ The Float Reno Experience ↤ Enjoy a self-guided river adventure through the heart of Reno Float through downtown Reno with sunshine overhead, skyline views around you, and plenty of Insta-worthy moments. Right now, the Truckee River is running with faster flows and lively currents, making this a more adventurous experience compared to a typical lazy float. We've got the rest covered: the tubes, transport, and everything in between. Your float is self-guided, and river conditions can vary, so be prepared for changing currents and an active day on the water. No timetables. No car juggling. Just show up ready for an unforgettable river adventure with your crew. What's Your Float Style? Two options designed around you: ALL Inclusive We provide all the gear, shuttle transportation, and personalized support on the water. All you need to do is show up. Bring Your Own Tube We'll provide the shuttle, inflation station, and support at launch. We can rent any additional float gear you may need. Pick the experience that fits your vibe. We've got you covered. Pick up cold drinks, sunscreen, water shoes, hats, dry bags, and other last-minute river gear right at our Welcome Center before getting on the shuttle. ↦ Book Now ↤ The Details Start your adventure at our Welcome Center at Idlewild Park, where you'll check in and hop on our complimentary shuttle. We'll take you upriver to the Launch Center at the Tom Cooke Trailhead, where you'll grab your gear, review river tips, and get float ready. Then it's go time: ease into the Truckee for a self-guided float lasting about 2 2.5 hours through cottonwood groves, scenic bends, and downtown skyline views. Please note: river conditions can vary and may include faster flows, small waves, and stronger currents, especially in early summer. Be ready for a more active, adventurous float. Reconnect with friends as you cruise all the way back to Idlewild Park, where you'll return your gear. After your float, enjoy a picnic in the park or check out one of our partner spots for great food and drinks! Arrival and Shuttle Pickup Information: Meet at the Welcome Center at Idlewild Park at least 30 minutes before your reservation time in order to check-in and catch the shuttle. The shuttle will leave promptly at your reservation time. ​ If you miss the shuttle at our Welcome Center, you will need to transport yourself directly to the Launch Center (15 minute drive). ​​​ ↦ The Scenic Truckee River Float River Route Launch from Tom Cooke Trailhead and float 2 2.5 hours to Idlewild Park, a short walk from Reno's Riverwalk District. ➤ Welcome Center by the river at Idlewild Park ➤ Complimentary shuttle to the river drop-in location ➤ GPS guidance and points of interest in the Float Reno app ➤ End back at the Welcome Center and grab any items you left with us ➤ After your float, enjoy nearby food and drink options at the Riverwalk View Today's Truckee River Float Conditions. Please note that trips may be delayed or canceled due to weather or higher river flows. River conditions can change, and currents may be faster and more active than expected. The whole setup felt thoughtful and professional. Reno's river scene is about to get a major upgrade. Shay M This is the kind of experience Reno has been missing! From start to finish, everything was seriously fun. Float Reno provided me with everything I needed for this adventure! Kat O I floated with a few friends as part of an early test run, and we couldn't stop talking about how cool the concept is. It's the perfect mix of adventure and chill can't wait for the official launch! Camper Shells - Custom Truck Accessories Skip to content Reno: (775) 329-5111 Carson City: (775) 885-8111 Mon–Fri 8AM–6PM | Sat 9AM–3PM Home Accessories RVs & Campers About Us Contact Home / Products / Camper Shells Camper Shells Camper Shells CTA has been Northern Nevada's top camper shell dealer since 1983. We stock the largest selection in the region. Whether you need a work cap, recreational shell, or commercial solution — we carry the best brands and install them right. Brands We Carry LEER · Snug Top · RSI SmartCap Get a Quote Call Reno: (775) 329-5111 Call Carson City: (775) 885-8111 What We Offer Camper Shells Options Leer Shell 100XL - Fiberglass Full-height fiberglass shells with windows, locks, and interior lighting. RSI Modular Breakout Lightweight, durable aluminum shells for work and recreation. Leer Commercial Shell - DDC Heavy-duty shells for fleet and commercial applications. Get a Quote Call Reno: (775) 329-5111 Call Carson City: (775) 885-8111 SnugTop SnugTop has been manufacturing truck caps in California since 1959 and they remain one of the most recognized names in the western market. Their Sport and Rebel models are among the most popular shells we sell — clean lines, solid construction, and a finish quality that holds up to Northern Nevada sun and temperature swings. SnugTop's one-piece fiberglass construction is notably stiff, which keeps the shell from flexing and creaking over time. Available in a wide range of colors with factory-match paint options. The SnugTop Super Sport is a popular step up from the standard Sport — slightly taller interior height and a more aggressive profile. Good option for truck owners who occasionally sleep in the shell or need the extra height for gear organization. RSI SmartCap RSI SmartCap is the premium option in our shell lineup and it's built for a completely different use case than a standard fiberglass cap. SmartCap's aluminum construction makes it exceptionally strong — it's designed to carry rooftop tents, solar panels, and full overland loads on the roof. The integrated side panel system uses a T-slot track that runs the full length of the interior, allowing direct attachment of DECKED drawers, lighting, shelving, and custom rigging without drilling. For serious overlanding builds, the SmartCap is in a different category from traditional fiberglass shells. RSI builds SmartCap in South Africa where the product was originally developed for the global 4x4 market, and the quality reflects that pedigree. If you're building a truck that will go to remote areas and needs to work hard, SmartCap is worth the investment. What We Carry Leer Camper Shells Leer is our flagship line and the shell we sell most. We're one of the exclusive Leer dealers in Northern Nevada, so we know the product cold and can custom-order any model in your truck's factory color. If you want a clean, well-built fiberglass cap that fits like it came from the factory, Leer is where the conversation usually starts. SnugTop Camper Shells SnugTop has been building fiberglass shells since 1960 and the craftsmanship shows. Their lineup covers everything from sleek recreational caps to purpose-built commercial options. Like Leer, we can custom order any model and handle the full installation in-house. RSI SmartCap The SmartCap is a stainless steel modular cap that's become popular with overlanders and work truck operators. Its biggest practical advantage for our customers is turnaround time: we stock units and typically have them assembled and ready to install within a day or two. If your timeline is tight or you want a cap that's ready to carry a rooftop tent right out of the gate, it's worth a close look. Go Fast Campers We're one of GFC's authorized dealer-installers in the region. Go Fast Campers makes the Platform Camper and Platform Topper, two of the most talked-about products in the overlanding world right now. If you're building a truck you want to actually live out of on the road, come in and we'll walk you through the lineup. Same-Day Installation Every shell we sell, we install. All shell installs are same-day. Come in, we'll get it on your truck before you leave. How Custom Orders Work Most fiberglass shells are custom ordered to your truck's specific bed size, cab configuration, and paint code. Lead times vary by brand and model, but we'll give you a real timeline when you come in. We also carry select shells in stock at both locations, so if you need to move quickly, call ahead and we'll let you know what's on the floor. Come In and Talk to Us Picking a shell is one of those decisions where a 20-minute conversation saves a lot of second-guessing. The differences between models, the tradeoffs between materials, what makes sense for your specific truck and how you use it: that's what we do every day. Walk-ins are welcome at both locations. Frequently Asked Questions What's the difference between a camper shell and a truck topper? Same product, different names. Camper shell, truck topper, truck cap, bed cap: all the same thing. The terminology varies by region. Can I get a shell color-matched to my truck? Yes. Leer and SnugTop both offer factory color-match. Give us your paint code and we'll order it to match. How long does installation take? All shell installs are same-day. We'll let you know a more specific timeframe when you schedule. Do you install on all makes and models? Ford, Toyota, Chevy, GMC, Ram, Nissan, and more. If there's a shell built for it, we can get it and install it. Can I add a roof rack to my shell? Yes. We work with Thule and Yakima rack systems and can spec the right setup with you when you come in. Get Started Interested in Camper Shells?
