Suspension Lifts - Custom Truck Accessories Skip to content Reno: (775) 329-5111 Carson City: (775) 885-8111 Mon–Fri 8AM–6PM | Sat 9AM–3PM Home Accessories RVs & Campers About Us Contact Home / Products / Suspension Lifts Suspension Lifts Suspension Lifts Get the clearance and stance you want with professionally installed suspension lifts. CTA has state-of-the-art alignment and installation equipment at both Reno and Carson City. Whether you need a leveling kit to eliminate factory rake or a full suspension system to conquer the trails, our factory-trained technicians will get the job done safely and correctly. Every lift includes a post-install alignment. Brands We Carry Rough Country · BDS · Fox · Bilstein · Old Man Emu · Icon Get a Quote Call Reno: (775) 329-5111 Call Carson City: (775) 885-8111 What We Offer Suspension Lifts Options Leveling Kit Eliminate factory rake and level your truck for a clean, aggressive look. Quick install with no loss of ride quality. Suspension Kits Full 2"–6" lift kits with upgraded shocks, springs, and control arms for maximum clearance and off-road performance. Get a Quote Call Reno: (775) 329-5111 Call Carson City: (775) 885-8111 Built for Northern Nevada A suspension setup that works well on a manicured trail in Southern California isn't necessarily the right choice for how Northern Nevada trucks actually get used. The terrain here ranges from high-speed desert flats east of Reno to rocky Sierra Nevada approaches to washboard forest service roads in the Pine Nut and Virginia Ranges. The speed and surface variety matters — a setup dialed for slow technical crawling will feel harsh and nervous at desert speeds, and vice versa. Most of our customers need a suspension that handles confidently at highway speed, absorbs the sustained chatter of maintained dirt roads, and still has enough articulation for the occasional technical section. That points toward quality coilovers with appropriate valving over budget monotube shocks — which is why we emphasize brands like ICON, Fox, and Bilstein over cheaper alternatives that look similar on spec sheets but behave very differently on Nevada roads. If you're building a truck specifically for desert racing or off-road performance, we build those too — but the conversation is different. Come in and tell us what you're doing with the truck. Leveling Kits A leveling kit corrects the factory rake most trucks come with from the manufacturer — the front sitting slightly lower than the rear to account for payload. If you're not carrying heavy loads regularly, that rake works against the truck's appearance and can limit the tire size you can run up front. A leveling kit typically lifts the front 1.5 to 3 inches to bring it even with the rear. It's a cleaner stance, it opens up your wheel and tire options, and on most trucks it's a relatively straightforward install. For a lot of daily drivers, a leveling kit with a good set of wheels and tires is the right answer and nothing more is needed. We do spacer-style leveling kits for customers where it makes sense, and strut-based kits where the truck and use case call for something more capable. We'll tell you the difference and what's right for your situation. Lift Kits Lift kits start where leveling kits leave off. Most of what we install falls in the 2 to 6 inch range, with the sweet spot for most customers around 3 to 4 inches — enough to run 33s or 35s comfortably, improve approach and departure angles meaningfully, and still keep the truck drivable every day without excessive wear or handling compromise. Beyond 6 inches, the build gets more involved. Larger lifts often require additional components: control arms, extended brake lines, adjustments to the front differential, and more careful attention to geometry. We do those builds too, and we'll walk you through what's actually required versus what's optional at each level. Body Lifts Body lifts raise the body of the truck off the frame using spacers, without changing the suspension geometry. They're a lower-cost way to clear larger tires without altering how the truck drives. Not right for every application, but a legitimate option in the right context. Suspension Lifts A full suspension lift modifies the truck's actual suspension components to increase ride height. Done properly it improves ground clearance, approach and departure angles, and off-road capability while maintaining or improving on-road ride quality. The quality of the components you choose matters a lot here, which is why we take brand and application seriously. Brands We Work With ICON Vehicle Dynamics ICON is our go-to for Toyota Tacoma builds and a strong choice across other platforms as well. Their coilovers and control arm kits are engineered for real-world performance, not just lift height, and they hold up well over time. Carli Suspension Carli is what we reach for on Ram builds. Their systems are specifically engineered around the Ram's front suspension geometry and designed for customers who want a truck that rides well on the highway, handles a load, and can go off-road without compromise. Rough Country Rough Country is our most commonly installed kit across a wide range of trucks and customers. It covers most popular platforms, the pricing is accessible, and for customers who want a solid lift without getting into premium pricing territory, the quality is there. ReadyLIFT ReadyLIFT makes some of the cleanest bolt-on leveling and lift kits available and is a go-to for Ram builds where a customer wants a quality result at a fair price. BDS Suspension BDS is a strong choice for Ram and full-size truck customers who want lift with more off-road intent. Their kits are designed with geometry and durability in mind. King Shocks King is the shock absorber of choice for serious off-road builds. When a customer wants the best performing suspension they can put on their truck, King shocks are usually in that conversation. Westcott Designs Westcott makes purpose-built lift and suspension kits for Toyota platforms — Tacoma, Tundra, and 4Runner specifically. A good fit for Toyota owners who want a system engineered specifically for their platform. Teraflex and Falcon Shocks Teraflex and their Falcon Shocks line are strong options for Jeep and truck builds where you want quality geometry correction alongside well-tuned damping. Hunter Alignment Rack Every suspension install we do gets a proper alignment. We run a Hunter alignment rack, which is the most precise and widely trusted alignment system in the industry. Most shops in the area are running older equipment — Hunter's current systems use imaging technology to take more measurement points faster and more accurately than traditional alignment equipment. The practical difference for you: the alignment is tighter, the printout is clear and readable so you can see exactly where your truck landed before and after, and you're not relying on equipment that was accurate when it was new. Suspension work without a proper alignment after is an unfinished job. We don't do it that way. Free Re-Torque Service After a suspension install, components settle as they go through their first heat cycles and miles. It's normal, and it's why we offer a free re-torque at around 500 miles after your install. You bring the truck back in, we check all the torque specs and make sure everything is still exactly where it should be. Most shops don't offer this. We do because it's the right way to finish the job. When you leave after a re-torque, you know the suspension is set correctly for the long term. Which Lift Is Right for Your Truck? That depends on more variables than most people expect when they first start looking. Tire size goals, daily driving versus trail use, towing or payload requirements, budget, and the specific platform all factor in. Choosing how to explore Lake Tahoe often comes down to one big question: Should you rent a boat or book a captained boat charter ? While both options get you out on the water, the experience can be completely different—especially on a lake known for sudden winds, strict boating rules, and some of the most unique navigation challenges in the country. This guide breaks down the real differences between boat rentals and charters , including safety, cost, alcohol rules, and overall enjoyment, so you can choose the option that gives you the best possible day on Lake Tahoe. Spoiler: for most visitors, a captained charter delivers a far more relaxing, safer, and more memorable experience. Boat Rental vs. Boat Charter: Quick Comparison Feature Boat Rental Captained Charter Captain Included ❌ No ✅ Yes (USCG licensed) Safety + Local Knowledge Dependent on renter Always included Fuel Costs Often extra Usually included Liability Higher (you drive) Minimal (captain responsible) Experience Split between driving and relaxing 100% relaxing and sightseeing Navigation Must handle docking, weather, and local rules Captain handles everything Alcohol Policy ❌ Operator cannot drink ✅ Passengers may drink with a captain Ideal For Experienced boaters Families, friends, groups, stress-free adventures When a Boat Rental Makes Sense A rental might be the right fit if you check most of these boxes: You have strong boating experience and enjoy driving You’re familiar with Lake Tahoe’s rules, winds, and navigation You want full control of the boat and itinerary You only need the boat for a short outing You’re comfortable handling docking, anchoring, and safety You don’t mind fuel charges, deposits, or added responsibilities When a Boat Charter Is the Better Choice A quick checklist to know if a captained charter is the better fit: You want a stress-free, fully guided experience You prefer to relax, take photos, and enjoy the scenery You want to drink alcohol without worrying about operating a boat You’re visiting Lake Tahoe for the first time You want to explore Emerald Bay and other top landmarks safely You have kids, a large group, or a special celebration You want a smoother ride with expert navigation in changing weather You want the best chance at an unforgettable, worry-free day on the lake Frequently Asked Questions About Boat Rentals vs. Charters in Lake Tahoe 1. What’s the main difference between a boat rental and a captained boat charter? A rental means you drive the boat yourself, while a captained charter includes a licensed captain who handles all navigation, safety, and lake knowledge so you can fully relax. 2. Are captained charters safer than renting a boat? Yes. Charters are operated by USCG-licensed captains who understand Tahoe’s winds, hazards, and boating rules—significantly reducing risk for passengers. 3. Which option offers a better overall experience? Most visitors prefer charters because everyone gets to relax, take photos, enjoy the scenery, and skip the stress of driving, docking, and monitoring lake conditions. 4. Is it cheaper to rent a boat than book a charter? Sometimes upfront—but rentals often add fuel charges, deposits, damage fees, and lost time learning the lake. Charters are typically the better value when considering the full experience. 5. Can I drink alcohol on a boat rental or charter? You cannot drink if you are operating a rental boat. Passengers can drink on a captained charter since the captain is the designated operator. 6. Can both rentals and charters go to Emerald Bay? Technically yes; however, charters are better equipped to navigate the channel, other boats, and no-wake areas—and they can share the history and stories that make Emerald Bay special. 7. Do I need boating experience to rent a boat on Lake Tahoe? Yes—renters are responsible for navigating strict no-wake zones, buoys, wind shifts, and docking. First-time or inexperienced boaters often struggle. 8. Which option saves more time on the water? Charters. You step onboard and go, while rentals require paperwork, instructions, fuel stops, and time learning the lake. 9. Which is better for families or larger groups? Charters are ideal—parents can relax, kids stay safer, and a captain ensures smooth conditions, easier routes, and local guidance. 10. Why are charters recommended for visitors new to Lake Tahoe? Tahoe’s deep water, sudden winds, and complex rules make self-driving challenging. Charters provide local expertise and a far more enjoyable, stress-free day. Where Life Intersects Work & Play About Soaring Ranch in Truckee / Tahoe ​ CONVENIENTLY located in one of Truckee's most vibrant and recreation-rich areas, Soaring Ranch is reimagining the best of Truckee in a neighborhood fully blended with housing, recreation, and commerce. ​ With bike path connections from the community to Martis Valley, Lake Tahoe, and the Truckee River Soaring Ranch visitors and future residents can take the bike path and pedestrian connections to access the area and beyond. ​ Enjoy vibrant shopping and dining services including Raley's grocery market, Mountain Hardware's second location, RE/MAX Gold, DLUX Window Coverings, Martis Valley Massage and more businesses at Soaring Ranch a hub of local living where everything is footsteps or pedal strokes away. Features Future Commercial & Residential Opportunities Soaring Ranch was founded on the belief that convenience and sustainability should go hand-in-hand. Having established a premier retail destination at the gateway to the Sierra in Phase 1, plans are in place for Phases 2 and 3: a multi-year expansion that integrates diverse workforce housing options with new restaurants and office spaces, all connected by the region's most accessible bike and pedestrian paths. ​ By integrating local living with recreation-rich design, Soaring Ranch is building a future where you can live, work, and play. Learn more about commercial opportunities and future workforce housing . Projects Contact 20-Minute Neighborhood Following the innovative planning principles of a 20-Minute Neighborhood where work, life and play all come together, Soaring Ranch is an answer to Truckee's housing, community character, sustainability and local business needs. Soaring Ranch opens up the endless possibilities that exist when housing is integrated with daily life the chance meetings of neighbors in the aisles of the market, on the bike path, or on the way to and from work. Or the ability to leave the car behind for days on end and still explore all that Truckee and North Tahoe have to offer. LOCATION Soaring Ranch is Located in Truckee, CA on the corner of Highway 267 & Soaring Way. ​ JOIN THE MAILING LIST Stores & Restaurants ​ News ​ Housing ​ ​ Contact ​ Terms & Conditions ​ Accessibility ​ Privacy Policy bottom of page

COMMERCIAL LEASING Phase 2: Expanding the Vision Building on the proven success of Phase 1, which is now 100% stabilized with long-term leases, Phase 2 offers a premier opportunity to join a thriving, established business community. ​ While Phase 1 set the standard for commercial viability on-site, Phase 2 expands this vision by introducing two new buildings featuring a strategic, horizontally mixed-use design. By positioning prime commercial spaces directly on Soaring Way and tucking residential units behind, the project maximizes visibility for tenants while protecting the privacy of the residential areas. ​ ​ CONTACT US Phase 2 Commercial Space Phase Two will include 22,000 square feet of premier, all-ground-floor commercial space, strategically designed for maximum visibility and ease of access. This expansive footprint will house new restaurants and retail businesses such as a pet store, pharmacy, and coffee shop curated to enhance residents' quality of life. Positioned as a distinct destination separate from the residential units, this project aims to fulfill a significantly underserved demand for high-traffic retail, office, F&B, and residential space on the east side of Truckee. Phase 2 Workforce Housing: Supporting Commercial Businesses The integration of Phase 2 and Phase 3 workforce housing at Soaring Ranch creates a captive and consistent market for our commercial partners. By adding over 200 residential units to the site, we are establishing a built-in neighborhood of high-frequency consumers who value the convenience of shopping and dining just steps from their front door. The housing units also helps stabilize the local labor market, making it easier for businesses to recruit and retain staff who live within the community. Learn more about Soaring Ranch's local housing here. ​ ​ About A Diverse Population Base Avg. Income: $180,000+ Avg. Home Price: $1,000,000+ ​ Truckee's area population has more than quintupled over the course of 25 years. About Truckee Approximately 4,000 professionals commute daily to Truckee year round. Seasonal jobs account for an additional 2,000 daily. ​ Truckee's base population is approximately 38,000 and it swells to over 80,000 during the peak summer and winter seasons. Location Soaring Ranch is the 1st shopping center built in over 25 years in Truckee and is the only shopping center located east of Downtown Truckee. ​ Over 1,000 hotel rooms are within a 10 minute drive. ​ Lake Tahoe enjoys over 24 million guest visits per year. Experience Lake Tahoe's only authentic paddle wheeler with departures to Emerald Bay from Tahoe City's North Shore. Book your unforgettable adventure today! View All Cruises Most popular! Emerald Bay Cruise From $ 97 Experience Lake Tahoe’s most spectacular sightseeing adventure on our signature 3.5-hour journey to Emerald Bay. Cruise past stunning lakefront estates, explore hidden coves, and witness the beauty of Vikingsholm Castle and Fannette Island. Delicious, chef-prepared lunch available for purchase. Learn More Tags 3.5 Hours , Daily Cruises Happy Hour Cruise From $ 70 Tags 1.5 Hours , Daily Cruises Happy Hour Cruise Kick-off your evening with Tahoe’s most scenic happy hour on our relaxing 90-minute afternoon cruise. Enjoy cocktails, wines, and delicious appetizers as you cruise past iconic lakefront landmarks. Watch the mountains glow in the golden afternoon light while our crew shares fascinating stories about Lake Tahoe’s history and hidden gems. Learn More Morning Sightseeing Cruise From $ 76.32 Tags 1.5 Hours , Daily Cruises Morning Sightseeing Cruise Begin your Lake Tahoe adventure with a delightful 90-minute morning cruise showcasing the lake’s pristine beauty. Savor a freshly prepared brunch while gliding past historic lakefront estates and taking in panoramic mountain views. Perfect for early risers who want to experience Tahoe’s clarity and calm morning waters before crowds arrive. Learn More Sunset Cruise From $ 82 Tags 2.5 Hours , Daily Cruises Sunset Cruise Discover why sunset on Lake Tahoe is pure magic on our 2.5-hour dinner cruise. Indulge in a chef-prepared dinner while the sky transforms into shades of orange, pink, and purple reflected in Tahoe’s crystal-clear waters. This combines dining, breathtaking scenery, and the romance of a paddle-wheeler cruise under alpine skies. Learn More An iconic 120 passenger paddle wheeler located in Lake Tahoe, California, The Tahoe Gal cruises to Emerald Bay and along the North and West Shores of Lake Tahoe. Meet The Tahoe Gal A Highlight of Our Trip We had the best time on the Happy Hour Cruise! The boat is charming and the views of the lake are stunning and beautiful! The staff were all incredibly friendly and accommodating from check in to the photo guy to the captain! We brought our own captain's hats to be goofy and the captain and staff got such a kick out of it that they let us get a look at the cockpit (is it a cockpit on a boat??) and pretend to drive! It was a fun, relaxing activity before going to dinner. Melissa B (TripAdvisor) Could not have been better! A group of 14 of us threw a surprise party for my wife, to celebrate an upcoming milestone birthday. The folks at the Tahoe Gal could not have been nicer! From the initial booking, they did everything with excellence. The music dinner cruise was extraordinary! The lake was calm. The views were stunning. The table for our group was perfect. The musicians were talented and even played Happy Birthday for my wife. The food was better than any restaurant (I had the prime rib ... not to be missed!). And I cannot say enough about our server, Christian. He was terrific and handled our large group with ease. Kudos, Tahoe Gal! Well done!!! J.K. Wilson (TripAdvisor) What a wonderful afternoon on Lake Tahoe! This was a perfect way to enjoy the lake. Took the Tahoe Gal over to Emerald Bay for a Sunday lunch cruise. The day was beautiful and the bay, beyond words. Enjoyed learning about the lake and the history of the area. The captain did a great job with all the information, however, the sound system could be improved. The food, albeit a bit pricey was good and the mixed drinks yum! The crew did a great job and were always smiling even though they were kept busy... Overall we loved it and would definitely do it again!!! We’re on a mission to cultivate a love of ice sports here in the high desert and ensure they are accessible to all. Meet Our Team A Community Ice Arena As a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, we exist to serve the people of the greater Reno area and provide a space for everyone to share the ice. Whether you’re a hockey player, figure skater, spectator, or trying ice skating for the first time, there’s a place for you in our growing community! About Us Ice Activities For Everyone Reno Ice is committed to helping every person participate in ice recreation, including kids, older folks, and people with disabilities. We proudly offer Learn to Skate for all ages, adaptive sled hockey, a financial aid program for young skaters, and more! Scholarships A Place to Learn & Grow More than just an ice rink, Reno Ice is a vibrant community hub where skaters of all backgrounds develop their skills and find encouragement from our team and expert coaches. Click below to find a session and discover your potential on the ice! Find an Event We’d love to host your next group event! Rent the Ice Community Reviews “Great facility and wonderful staff! The coaches are super supportive and always have a great plan set up for each session for the different age groups. I could not be happier with the culture of this establishment and would highly recommend taking your children here or coming yourself.” - Ryan A. “Amazing facility. Clean, organized, great staff and coaches and they have the best hockey program and skating for all ages.” - Shannon L. “Best sports community in Reno. My daughter said she wanted to do hockey 5 years ago and since then the community at Reno Ice has wrapped their arms around her and taken her in. Reno Ice has been a blessing for my daughter.” - Mica R. “I'm such a fan of Reno Ice. They have truly brought this community together. They have something for everyone in the family, even if you just want to sit and watch. It's great knowing that all of my friends with kids, have kids enrolled in either Hockey, figure skating, skating clinics, handicapped skating. This place has it all. The staff are all amazing. HUGE FAN!” - - Michelle H. Looking for information/tickets for the Reno Ice Raiders or Nevada Hockey? Reno Ice is the perfect place to host birthdays, school outings, corporate gatherings, and private parties. Our team will help you create a memorable experience that’s easy to plan and exciting for everyone in your group! 🥳 Plan Your Gathering at Reno Ice Let’s get your special event on the calendar! From ice time to tables for refreshments, we’ll work with you on a package that’s right for your group. Reno Ice is a great venue for Birthday parties Company events Community groups Camps Clinics and more! Email Mallory at mallory@renoice.com to discuss availability and rates, or use the form below to get started with your booking. Rental Packages Locker Room Rental - $125 With this package, you’ll have access to a private locker room 30 minutes before and after any scheduled Public Skate (which can range from one hour to two hours). This room rate does not include standard admission for Public Skates ($12 per person, $6 for children under 4), rental skates ($5 per pair), and skate aids ($5 each with a maximum of 20). Tables and chairs are provided in the locker room. This is an excellent choice for smaller parties that do not need to rent out the whole ice. Ice Rentals - $435/hour Reserve the entire ice for your party! This all-inclusive rate covers your admission, all skate rentals, and skate aids if you need them (with a maximum of 20). You can choose the music, and we’ll put on special lighting or disco effects if you so choose. Tables and chairs will also be provided to you to hold snacks, gifts, etc. If you have a large party and/or want to have the ice to yourselves, you’ll want to reserve an entire ice rental. Please see below for our private rental booking policy. Private Event Booking Policy Private rentals booked more than a month in advance require a deposit of 25% of the total booking fee. We will not place your event on our schedule until the deposit has been paid. The rental fee must be paid in full one month prior to your event. For last-minute bookings/events arranged less than a month in advance, the full rental fee must be paid in full when booking . Failure to pay the full amount may result in losing your timeslot. Questions? Email mallory@renoice.com. Reno Ice, The Jennifer M. Skate Sharpening and Repairs at Reno Ice Sharpening - $12 We offer skate sharpening on our Blackstone machine. Our experienced sharpeners will get your skates to the exact edge you need to perform at your best. Please note: We charge $15 for a rush order (skates needed the next day that are dropped off after 5pm.) Rockering - $40 Also called “profiling” or “contouring,” rockering is the process of creating a custom curvature on your blade, and can help with maneuverability or performance. Please come by the front desk to chat with us about getting your skates rockered! Repairs - Custom Need a repair on your figure or hockey skate? We may be able to help. Contact mallory@renoice.com to inquire. If we are not able to repair your skate, we may be able to provide a recommendation for where to access the right service. To get skates sharpened or rockered, please drop them off at the front desk. A staff member will take your name, contact information, preferred edge (see below), and the date you need them by. You can pay when you drop them off or at the time of pick up. Note: We ask that you take your skate guards/soakers off prior to leaving your skates. If you have questions about our sharpening, repair, or rockering services, please send an email to mallory@renoice.com. Thank you! Reno Ice, The Jennifer M. pages.text: KJ's Watersports Lake Tahoe About Rates Smartwaiver Gallery Testimonials Contact About Rates Smartwaiver Gallery Testimonials Contact Scroll KJ'S WATERSPORTS Learn to ride on Lake Tahoe Make a reservation Your Fun Starts here Located on the shores of South Lake Tahoe about us KJ’s Watersports provides everything needed for an amazing and memorable experience on the water. We offer customized wakeski, wakeboard, wakesurf, wakefoiling, and wakeskate lessons for all abilities from first timers to advanced, all while in the setting of your very own private boat. We specialize in providing you with in-water instruction to guarantee the best use of your time while with us, however if you’d like to be in the water solo we are happy to accommodate that too! All our Captains are licensed through the USCG and all instructors are professionally trained with a true passion for sharing high fives and smiles. Come jump in the the water with us and experience why KJ’s is the go-to spot for kind, trusted, Lake Tahoe water shredding fun everyone will enjoy! all skills & ages welcomed Whether you're a first timer or an experienced rider looking for some fun in the sun, we got you covered. What to expect All lessons include: A private boat setting for up to 6 individuals at a time per coast guard regulations, excluding crew. We use a Nautique Super Air 210, and a Sport Nautique 216 for lessons. A Driver An in-water instructor Fuel (no hidden fill up charge, its built into the price) All gear included such as skis, tubes, foils, wakeboards, kneeboards, wake skates, wake surfers. Pickup locations all over the lake, just let us know where you’ll be and we can come to you. Everything else needed for a good time on the water, you just need to bring towels and a swim suit. view gallery Water-ski lesson Lake Tahoe Kj's Watersports Lake Tahoe Homepage Home - Your fun starts here Home - Tuber What to expect KJ'S WATERSPORTS 2200 Baldwin Beach Rd, South Lake Tahoe, CA, 96150, United States 5305233034 info@kjswatersports.com Hours Mon 7am-7pm Tue 7am-7pm Wed 7am-7pm Thu 7am-7pm Fri 7am-7pm Sat 7am-7pm Sun 7am-7pm (530) 489-8180 • info@kjwatersports.com Powered by Squarespace

pages.text: Reno Tennis Center: Courts & Facilities - Tennis Nation Skip to primary navigation Skip to main content Skip to footer Tennis Nation Be Relentless Pickleball Pickleball Lessons in Reno Pickleball Classes & Clinics in Reno Pickleball Leagues in Reno Pickleball Open Play Junior Pickleball Adult Pickleball Pathway Pickleball Camps Indoor Pickleball in Reno (Guide) Tennis Tennis Lessons in Reno Tennis Classes & Clinics Tennis Leagues & Teams Junior Tennis Pathway Adult Tennis Programs Tennis Camps Play & Compete Ladders & Match Play in Reno Tournaments & Events Reno Tennis Center Pickleball Courts in Reno Tennis Courts in Reno Memberships & Benefits CourtReserve Booking Help Private & Group Rentals Sponsorships Resources Free Lessons WhatsApp Communities (Tennis & Pickleball) Shop Tennis Racquets Pickleball Paddles Demo Program Racquet Stringing Contact & FAQs Reno Tennis Center — Reno’s Public Racquet Sports Facility The Reno Tennis Center is the heart of racquet sports in Reno, Nevada — a community-focused, city-accessible facility where players of all ages and abilities come together to play, learn, compete, and connect through tennis and pickleball. Operated by Tennis Nation Racquet Sports in partnership with the City of Reno, this is a true civic facility built for everyday players, families, newcomers, and lifelong athletes. Facility Overview Located at 2601 Plumas Street beside the Washoe County Golf Course, the Reno Tennis Center offers year-round outdoor play across one of Northern Nevada’s largest racquet sports footprints. This is not a private club—it’s a public, welcoming destination designed for access, consistency, and community. 10 Tennis Courts (6 lighted for evening play) 24 Pickleball Courts (12 lighted for night sessions) Large Hitting Wall for solo practice and warm-ups 3 Playmate Tennis Ball Machines (free for members) 2 Lobster Pickleball Machines (free for members) On-court player seating and spectator seating throughout the facility Front desk services for check-in, reservations, and information Online booking and scheduling through CourtReserve Full-Service Onsite Pro Shop with racquet sports essentials The Reno Tennis Center is designed to remove friction from play. Players can arrive without gear and still be fully equipped. The onsite pro shop offers racquets, paddles, balls, shoes, apparel, grips, drinks, snacks, and professional stringing services—so everything you need is in one place. New players are also welcome to try the sport before investing in equipment. The Reno Tennis Center offers loaner and demo tennis racquets and pickleball paddles, so you can step on court even if you don’t yet own gear. It’s one more way the facility keeps racquet sports accessible, welcoming, and easy to begin. The layout is intentionally open and social. You’ll see beginners learning the game, competitive players drilling, families sharing courts, and friends meeting for casual play—all in the same space. Plan Your Visit Quick links to help you arrive prepared and confident. Get Directions Court Map Live Court Conditions Sports at Reno Tennis Center Tennis Tennis has long been part of Reno’s athletic fabric, and the Reno Tennis Center is where it lives today. With ten full-size courts, dedicated lighting, and room for everything from casual rallies to organized competition, the facility supports players at every stage. Explore: Tennis Courts at Reno Tennis Center Tennis Court Availability & Booking Tennis Programs & Instruction Whether you’re returning to the sport or stepping on court for the first time, this is Reno’s home base for tennis. Pickleball Pickleball is thriving in Reno, and the Reno Tennis Center is its primary public hub. With 24 dedicated courts and daily activity from morning through evening, players can find open play, social sessions, and structured opportunities in one place. Explore: Pickleball Courts at Reno Tennis Center Open Play Pickleball Options Pickleball Programs & Pathways The scale of the facility allows beginners, social players, and competitive athletes to coexist without friction—each group has space to play the way they want. Who This Facility Is For The Reno Tennis Center is built for: New residents looking for ways to get active and meet people Beginners exploring tennis or pickleball Families and juniors developing skills and confidence Active adults seeking consistent social play Experienced players pursuing structured competition You don’t need a background in racquet sports to belong here. You don’t even need a membership to walk in and play. This is a public facility first and always. Professional Instruction on Site The Reno Tennis Center is operated by Tennis Nation Racquet Sports, a local organization that provides professional coaching, junior development, adult programs, and competitive pathways for both tennis and pickleball. Players who want structured instruction, leagues, or long-term development can explore our coaching team and program pathways below. Explore Pickleball Programs & Pathways Explore Tennis Programs & Pathways How to Get Started Create your free CourtReserve account to unlock booking and program access. Reserve a court online or check in at the front desk when you arrive. Choose how you want to play—casual, social, instructional, or competitive. Everything flows through CourtReserve so you always know what’s happening and when. No guesswork. No gatekeeping. Just clear access to play. Create a Free CourtReserve Account View Court Availability Why Reno Tennis Center Is Different Public by Design: This is a city-backed facility built for access, not exclusivity. True Multi-Sport Hub: Tennis and pickleball are supported at scale, side by side. Room to Grow: Beginners, social players, and competitors all have space to belong. Modern Operations: CourtReserve keeps booking and communication simple. Fully Supported Experience: Courts, coaching, equipment, and essentials are all in one place. Community First: The culture here is welcoming, not intimidating. This isn’t just a place to play. It’s where Reno’s racquet sports community lives. Swimming in the pristine turquoise waters of Lake Tahoe is totally safe - with one big caveat (and no buddy, we don't mean Tahoe Tessie ): The water in Tahoe is cold, particularly the further you get from shore where the water is deep. Remember all the snow-capped mountains and all the things we talked about the world famous ski resorts ? That said, during the summer months, the weather is nice and warm so a dip in the lake is always refreshing. Crash Pad Rentals - Blue Granite Climbing Gym Skip to main content Close Search Menu Waiver Home Crash Pad Rentals Day Use Punch Passes Membership Yoga & Fitness Classes & Private Lessons Youth Teams & Clubs Homeschool Voucher FAQs Groups & Parties Events & Gatherings Community Climbing Initiative Contact Us facebook instagram Crash Pad Rentals $25/ Day - Book up to 30 Days in Advance! Crash Pad Rentals $25 per day Renting is EASY! Fill out a gym waiver, then call the gym to reserve your pad. You pay at the time of the reservation. Upon arrival, fill out a crash pad rental agreement & release of liability. Know where to go? Need help? We have guide books for sale too! Step 1 Gym Waiver Step 2 Call the Gym Rental Terms: Rent gear at Blue Granite Climbing Gym in person. Pay up to 30 days in advance. Pay in full when booking. Keep a credit card on file. Rent gear for up to 7 days. Re-rent if no conflicts. Pick up anytime on booking day. Return by the same time the next day. Late return fees: 0-24 hours late: $25 24-48 hours late: $60 48-72 hours late: $95 Over 72 hours late: Full price of pad $20 cleaning fee for very dirty gear- determined by Blue Granite staff. Incurred damages cost $50 or more. Treat gear well. Don’t use on wet/muddy ground. Pay any late or damage fees when returning gear. Gym can refuse to rent to anyone they think might be unsafe. 2026 Blue Granite Climbing Gym. Day Use - Blue Granite Climbing Gym Skip to main content Close Search Menu Waiver Home Crash Pad Rentals Day Use Punch Passes Membership Yoga & Fitness Classes & Private Lessons Youth Teams & Clubs Homeschool Voucher FAQs Groups & Parties Events & Gatherings Community Climbing Initiative Contact Us facebook instagram Day Use Day Passes, Rental Gear, & Belay Certifications Day Passes Day passes allow unlimited access to climbing, yoga & fitness classes, and cardio/free weight equipment all day on day purchased. MIN AGE FOR CLIMBING = 5 MIN AGE FOR YOGA = 14 MIN AGE FOR FITNESS EQUIP & WEIGHTS = 14 One Day Pass $25 Gear Rentals Climbing shoes, harnesses, and chalk bags are available to rent for the prices listed below. Belay devices are available for free with ID. Gear Rental Package $8 Includes shoes, harness & chalkbag Shoe Rental $5 Harness Rental $5 Chalk Bag Rental $2 Belaying Belay certification is required for all top rope belayers and lead belayers/climbers. MIN AGE FOR TR BELAY = 12 MIN AGE FOR LEAD CLIMB = 12 MIN AGE FOR LEAD BELAY = 14 Top Rope and Lead Belay Tests Free Offered at any time (at staff member's discretion). Belay cards will be issued after passing a belay test. Top Rope Belay Class $10 Offered any time (at staff member's discretion). Temporary belay card will be issued at the end of class. Participant must re-test the next time they come in to get a permanent belay card. Save time, purchase online … Please follow these steps to create an account, fill out waivers, and purchase day passes online ahead of time. This is especially helpful if you have antsy children who just want to get climbing! STEP 1: CREATE ACCOUNT Click the link below to create an account or login to an existing account. Only create one account per family (you can add additional family members to your account). ACCOUNT HOLDER MUST BE AN ADULT (18+). If you are signing a waiver for a minor, create an account for yourself, then add the minor to your household. STEP 2: ADD FAMILY MEMBERS Adding family members does not create a "family membership"; it merely creates a billing relationship, making it easy for you to purchase any kind of membership, punch passes or day passes for anyone in your family. STEP 3: SIGN WAIVERS Check the boxes next to all family members names, and poof! their information will autofill from their account to their waiver, making the waiver-signing process super easy. STEP 4: PURCHASE PASSES Click on the "Purchase a pass/membership page" and choose whatever kind of pass you would like and assign it to whichever family member(s) you would like. Passes/memberships will be automatically loaded on to the person's account so all they have to do is check-in. Create an Account Or Login to an Existing Account 2026 Blue Granite Climbing Gym. pages.text: Tahoe Fly Fishing - Home 0 Skip to Content Home Services Classes Travel Shop Report Book a Guide Open Menu Close Menu Home Services Classes Travel Shop Report Book a Guide Open Menu Close Menu Home Services Classes Travel Shop Report Book a Guide Lake Tahoe’s Fly Shop & Guide Service Book a Guide Welcome to Tahoe Fly Fishing Outfitters! Located on the south shore of Lake Tahoe offering the most complete fly fishing outfitter and shop for all things fly fishing in the Sierra. Private Water: Guided Fly Fishing Adventures to East Peak Lake Stay close to Stateline and get all the adventure! An epic trip for families and small groups on East Peak Lake at Heavenly Mountain Resort. Take the Scenic Gondola and an off-road trail ride in a UTV with your group up to private East Peak Lake . This 3-hour excursion includes an introduction to casting and guided fly fishing, the gondola ride, and an off-road trail ride. Learn More Off-Road Adventure Guided Fly Fishing Packages Jump in one of our 4-Seater UTV Off-Road side-by-sides and buckle up for a fly fishing experience like no other. We’ll take you to remote sections of water with fewer footprints and fish that don’t get to see a lot of flies. Our remote locations offer unparalleled beauty with outstanding fishing. Learn More Private Water: Fly Fishing Adventures on Sawmill Lake! Tahoe Fly Fishing Outfitters offers exclusive access to the picturesque Sawmill Lake located in North Lake Tahoe on the Northstar Resort. The 10-acre lake offers anglers of all abilities the shot at trophy rainbow or brown trout on the fly. Sight cast dry flies at cruising fish or strip streamers deep and enjoy the view! Learn More Guided Fly Fishing The Tahoe area offers an abundance of opportunity to chase trout and other species on the fly. Book your fly fishing adventure today! Rivers: Truckee River, Little Truckee, East Carson, West Carson, East Walker, West Walker, and more. Lakes: Sawmill Lake, Caples Lake, Red Lake, Blue Lakes, Silver Lake, Boca Reservoir, Stampede, and more. Learn More Fly shop with all the gear Whether you’re just getting started or building your arsenal, our fly shop has everything needed to get you on the water and keep you there. Premium products from Simms Fishing, Howler Brothers, Scott Fly Rods, Ross, Galvan, Fishpond, and more. Just getting started, or building an arsenal, our staff is here to help. We also offer a full complement of fly tying materials to customize your ‘secret weapon’ and add your own style to your bugs. Check out our online store for TFFO swag and gear! Shop Gear Classes and Clinics We offer courses for all anglers at every skill level designed to be engaging and make you a better angler. Group clinics bring people together around the love of fly fishing. TFFO creates a social atmosphere by partnering with local vendors and accommodations to deliver a fun and educational experience in small group settings. Upcoming Clinics A better fly fishing adventure with Tahoe Fly Fishing Outfitters Book a Trip Lake Tahoe’s #1 Guide Outfitter. Learn from the best. Tahoe Fly Fishing Outfitters 2705 Lake Tahoe Blvd., South Lake Tahoe, CA 96150 (530) 541-8208 Contact Us Copyright All Rights Reserved © 2024 Site Map Guide Service Classes Travel Shop Follow Instagram YouTube

Guided Trips and Services Tahoe Fly Fishing 0 Skip to Content Home Services Classes Travel Shop Report Book a Guide Open Menu Close Menu Home Services Classes Travel Shop Report Book a Guide Open Menu Close Menu Home Services Classes Travel Shop Report Book a Guide Guided Fly Fishing Adventures The pro staff at Tahoe Fly Fishing Outfitters has the experience and knowledge to put you on fish and help you grow your knowledge and skill set. We specialize in ‘catch & release’ fly fishing for both walk & wade and lake fishing. Strip streamers to large aggressive trout, nymph to holding fish, or target them with a well placed dry fly. Our guides will make sure to provide lasting memories, big smiles and the shot at a fish of a lifetime. 1/2 - Day Trip $450 ½ Day trips are 4 hours of on the water time. This does not include drive time to and from the river. A half day trip usually runs 6 hours of total time. Book a Trip 3/4 - Day Trip $550 ¾ Day trips are 6 hours of on the water time. This does not included drive time to and from the river. A ¾ day trip usually runs 8 hours total time. Boook a Trip Full - Day Trip $650 Full day trips are 8 hours of on the water time. This does not include drive time to and from the river. A full day trip usually runs 10 hours of total time. Book a Trip Off-Road Guided Fishing for 2: $1100 6 Hours of on water walk & wade guided fly fishing. This does not include drive time to and from the river. Complete trip time can range from 8 - 10 hours. Book a Trip Off-Road Guided Fishing for 3: $1300 6 Hours of on water walk & wade guided fly fishing. This does not include drive time to and from the river. Complete trip time can range from 8 - 10 hours. Book a Trip Off-Road Guided Fishing up to 9 anglers We offer an off-road trips for up to 9 anglers. No experience needed and an exciting private trip for your group with all the gear included. Book a Trip PRIVATE WATER: Sawmill Lake - Rod Fees Half and Full Day rod fees will give up to 4 anglers access to the private 10-acre Lake located on the Northstar Resort. Loaded with Rainbows and some big browns, this is an awesome private experience. Contact Us PRIVATE WATER: Sawmill Lake - Guided Trips Get out on Sawmill Lake with a guide and learn the skills to chase big and fight big lake rainbows and brown trout. This is a great opportunity to take in the beauty of the Sierra on your own private lake. Contact Us PRIVATE WATER: Sawmill Lake Float Tube Trip for 2 It’s more than just a guided trip on a private lake. This 2 Angler guided trip uses comfy float tubes for a leisurely kick around the lake. Fishing from a tube gives you a better shot at big rainbows lurking in the deep. Contact Us Spring Shad Float Trip Super fun float on the American River to chase sea run shad with a fly rod. This is a good one if you want shots at aggressive, hard-pulling fish. Learn More PRIVATE WATER: Sawmill Lake A private 10-acre lake on the Northstar Resort property holding trophy rainbow trout. Walk the banks for cruising fish or cast from float tubes in this incredible setting. Learn More Nor Cal Advanced Angler's Fish Camp: May 28 - 31, 2026 A private fish camp minutes from the McCloud River featuring outfitter tent accommodations set amongst the Aspens, Cedars, and Pines of Squaw Valley in McCloud, CA. Learn More PRIVATE WATER: Heavenly Mountain Resort Join us on a private lake in South Lake Tahoe on the Heavenly Mountain Resort. Take the scenic gondola up the mountain to our private East Peak Lake. Learn More Stillwater Ice Out Clinic Spring brings warmer temps and melting ice. The fish are hungry and ready to bulk back up. Limited spots available for the first shots at big lake fish. Learn More Clinics & Classes Casting Clinic, Fly Tying, Entomology, Advanced Techniques, and more. We have classes for all skill levels. Check out our courses and elevate your skills! View Courses Truckee/Carson River Float A drift on an Eastern Sierra River is an angler’s treat and affords different opportunities on the river. Contact us to learn about our float trips. Learn More Large Group/Team Building We can host large group fly fishing adventures. Looking for a private setting, or wanting to get your group out on the river? Let us create a trip for you. Contact Us Guide Pro Staff Jarrod Beer, GUIDE Jarrod has fished the Sierras his entire life and 20 years of guiding has given him incomparable tools for sharing knowledge and his passion for fly fishing. Alyssa Evart, GUIDE No river too far and with a quiver of tricks she has made a name for herself with a fly rod. Whether chasing backcountry goldens or Steelhead on the coast she is happy in the water. Taylor Norton, GUIDE Taylor grew up fishing Long Island Sound, He moved west and honed his skills on western trout running pack trips in the Rockies. His passion for teaching makes for a a memorable trip for his clients. Jason Shaw, GUIDE A true outdoorsman who spends a lot of time on the water and sure to create a memorable day for his guests on his home waters Chad Fuller, GUIDE Chad has carried a fly rod all over the western seaboard from baja to Alaska and hunts the flats for saltwater big game every chance he gets. Guests are sure to enjoy the knowledge and good times that come with a day on the water. Drew Johnston, GUIDE & GEAR GURU “Yo!” Drew is a good time on the water with strong knowledge of Tahoe’s surrounding steams and stillwaters. For float tube and walk & wade trips Drew has the map and ties the bugs to find big fish. Jasper Donley, GUIDE A 4-Season mountain native with great knowledge of stillwater and rivers around the Sierra. You’ll find him on the water or on the slopes 8 days a week. Drew Litzinger, GUIDE “Litz” has the fishing bug like few other when it comes to Sierra trout. He’s comfortable in a float tube in the high alpine, in a drift boat, or walking a river. A great teacher for all and feel safe with his fire fighting, EMT background. John Brassfield, OWNER & GUIDE DIRECTOR John has spent the last 15 years hunting for fabled fish. The big fish of the McCloud are where this passion started. Now more than ever he finds his heart’s desires on the flats chasing permit. Jacob Smith, GUIDE & SHOP TEAM Jacob might love trout fishing more than any of us. His pursuit and passion is on full display whether around the counter at the shop or riverside with his clients. Mike Patten, BASS GUIDE Our dedicated bass guide who knows the ins and outs of float and fly, striper fishing, and conventional bass fishing. He even comes with a boat! Bob Caron, GUIDE Bobby has a good time on the water and has a great way of becoming fast friends with whoever he fishes with. Whether on an off-road trip, hosted travel or around camp, Bob has you entertained. Cancellation Policy for all guided and unguided services. Cancellations made 7 days or more in advance of scheduled trip will receive a 100% refund. Cancellations made within 7-3 days prior to your scheduled trip will be charged 50% of guide rates or services. Cancellations made within 72 hours of the scheduled trip will not receive a refund or transfer and will be charged full guides rates. Tahoe Fly Fishing Outfitters 2705 Lake Tahoe Blvd., South Lake Tahoe, CA 96150 (530) 541-8208 Contact Us Copyright All Rights Reserved © 2024 Site Map Guide Service Classes Travel Shop Follow Instagram YouTube

pages.text: Wakesurf Wakeboard Lessons | Captain Jack's | North Lake Tahoe top of page Home More Use tab to navigate through the menu items. Water Sports For All Levels Surf - Board - Cruise Step aboard your luxury surf boat experience on Lake Tahoe. ​ Whether your looking to surf, wake board, ski, tube or just cruise the shores to Emerald Bay or Thunderbird Lodge, we guarantee your family and friends will smile and enjoy your time aboard Captain Jack's Tahoe. The Boat At 23.5 feet our brand new Axis T23 is a big, traditional-bow with all the features you need to make memories and a phenomenal wake. The available Power Wedge III, Surf Gate and Surf Band refine the T23's wave potential into thigh-high, glassy swells that you can control while you're surfing. The spacious interior equipped with a sliding, rear-facing Skybox Seat and installed pop-up rear facing back rests gives passengers a better view of the action. You'll have plenty of room to lounge in a relaxed seating configuration as you watch your friends enjoy the endless wave. ​ ​ LETS RIDE Get on Lake Tahoe! USCG Licensed Captain, Gas, Water-sports Equipment & Wetsuits are included with every session. Expect that each person will take a minimum of 30-60 minutes/water-sport.. Please let us know each riders size and ability so we can have the proper equipment prepared for your charter. Questions/Concerns please contact us. FAQ's CONTACT ME Tahoe City, Ca Dave@CaptainJacksTahoe.com 650-678-5521 Thanks for submitting! Submit Where do you pick-up? We offer pick-ups in North and West Shores of Lake Tahoe between Garwoods and Tahoma for free. We can also arrange private dock pick-ups anywhere on the lake for added charge. How do I book a session? Please call us direct 650-678-5521. After a refundable deposit of $500 is received, you will be scheduled for your private charter. What to bring? We suggest bringing towels, non-spray sunscreen, warm apparel, sunglasses, hat and any food/drink of your pleasure. How do I pay? We accept major credit cards, venmo, paypal, cash or check. Tips are greatly appreciated! What not to bring? Red wine, high heels/hiking boots, pets, doritos/cheetos chips that crumble easily, chicken wings. Can we play our own music? Yes! We have bluetooth connectivity and USB port for charging needs. What is your cancellation policy? We have a 72-hour cancellation policy with no refund for all charters. If weather is a problem on the day of your charter, such as a lake wind advisory for small watercraft during your booking time, or AQI is above 200 we offer full refund or reschedule. 2 HOUR SESSIONS $699 Schedule a Session 4 HOUR SESSIONS $1299 Schedule a Session 8 HOUR SESSIONS $2399 Schedule a Session 650-678-5521 ©2019 by Captain Jack's. pages.text: Tahoe Swell Seekers | Enjoy Lake Tahoe Water Sports Today 0 Skip to Content About Gallery Contact FAQ Book now Open Menu Close Menu About Gallery Contact FAQ Book now Open Menu Close Menu About Gallery Contact FAQ Book now LAKE TAHOE watersports charters wakesurfing &wakeboarding lessons captain included Premium wake boat rentals BOOK NOW Tahoe Swell Seekers is a luxury boat charter company operating in lake tahoe THAT PROVIDES epic daYS OUT ON THE LAKE FOR YOU AND YOUR GROUP DOESN’T MATTER IF ITS YOUR FIRST RIDE OR YOUR BEST RIDE, we’re ALL ABOUT GREAT WAVES, GREAT VIBES, AND AN UNFORGETTABLE TIME ON THE WATER All the Watersports Wakesurfing Looking to surf on one of the best boat waves in the industry? Our MB B52 has a fully adjustable wave that caters to all skill levels. Whether you’re looking to get up on the board for the first time, surf without the rope, or looking to learn spins and tricks, we’ve got you covered. Wakeboarding Although not as popular as wakesurfing these days, we LOVE getting people strapped into some bindings and getting out behind the boat! Never done it before? No problem! Wakeboarding is a great transition from snowboarding and surfing so you can still work on those skills all summer long. Foiling Have you mastered wakesurfing and are ready to take it to the next level? We offer wake foiling for those who are very experienced with wakesurfing or who already have experience with the foil. Our foil sessions will include all the tips and techniques to get you proficient and flying effortlessly through the water. This is the closest feeling to riding powder on a board! Grab your spot the boat 23’ MB Sports B52 Alpha 4800 pounds of ballast Fully Adjustable waves 400 horsepower engine Tower board racks Bimini shade cover Exile audio surround sound 15 inch subwoofer Switch on the fly surf tabs Spacious interior Built in cooler How many people can you accomodate? We allow up to 10 guests per booking! If you have more than 10 people in your group then we can arrange to get 2 or more boats booked for your group for the day. What do we need to bring? We always recommend bringing your own towels, snacks, swimwear, and beverages. We will provide coolers, wakeboards, surfboards, tubes, wetsuits and life vests. We can also provide ice for the coolers for an additional charge. Do you allow pets? Unfortunately your furry friends paws can damage the upholstery in the boat and pet hair is always a massive pain to get out of the boat. Please leave your pets at home! Do we have to get in the water? When you book with us, we will tailor the day however you like! Watersport activities are always optional.We offer sightseeing cruises, scenic tours, and can take you wherever you want to go. What is your cancellation policy? We allow cancellation for a full refund up to 7 days before your booking. If you want to cancel within 7 days of your booking, we will refund you with a credit for the full amount you paid for a future booking with us. There will be no refunds for cancellations made within 24 hours. Frequently Asked Questions ‍ ‍ @ tahoeswellseekers LAKE TAHOE TAHOESWELLSEEKERS@GMAIL.COM (707) 294- 8757 (707) 320-8923

All of which can easily top 20" and send you into your backing faster than the most brazen bonefish. 35 Years of Truckee Mastery Your Guide Matt "Gilligan" Koles is the living legend of the Truckee, a master guide with over 3 decades of Truckee expertise under his belt. Gilligan is not just a guide; he's a nationally recognized fly tier, and a pioneer of tight-line nymphing, reshaping the very landscape of fly fishing on these storied waters. As the most sought-after guide in the area, Gill's passion for the river is matched only by his unwavering dedication to ensuring every angler who wades alongside him or steps aboard his boat leaves with memories that will last a lifetime. Rest assured, with Gill at the helm, your fishing dreams are not just within reach -- they're practically guaranteed. Fish with Gill Experience the Majesty Big river, bigger fish Flowing 106 miles from Lake Tahoe to Pyramid Lake, the Truckee is truly the playground of giants. It's meandering path flows through the rugged beauty of the Sierra's, the casino chaos of downtown Reno, and the sage-filled high desert on it's way to Pyramid Lake. There's a lot of river to cover, and it's not easy to know where to go. We'll shorten your learning curve, and make sure you end your trip with great memories, and a notebook of wisdom. I got into some nice fish, but more than the fishing, Matt is just an enjoyable dude to spend time with on the river. An excellent day on the river! Bob L. More Reviews Let's Go Fishing! Hold the trout of your lifetime in your hands! Book Now Frequently Asked Questions What's Included? Flies are provided on all guide trips, as well as additional gear if required (waders, boots, etc.) at no cost. Waters are provided, but guests should bring any snacks and lunches. We fish aggressively and continuously, and don't stop for long lunches, which is why the full day options are around 6 hrs. Believe me, you'll be exhausted from roping fish at the end of the day! What's the Cancellation Policy Deposits for canceled guide trips will be refunded in full with a 30 day or more notice. Cancellations within 30 days will forfeit all deposit monies. If we are able to re-book the guide, we will refund the deposit or apply it to a trip at a later date. If a trip is cancelled with less than 72 hours notice, the full price of the guide trip will be charged. Our guide trips go out in all safe weather and water conditions, therefore inclement weather, water levels or undesirable fishing conditions are NOT acceptable reasons to cancel or receive a refund. Trips cancelled by the guide or mutual guide/client decision due to unsafe weather or water conditions, state or federal closures, or other uncontrollable circumstances will have the entire deposit refunded. Where will we fish? Depending on whether you book a walk&wade or a float (drift boat) trip, we will seek out whatever stretch of river that is fishing well. We are on the river almost daily, so we're intimately attuned to the conditions, flows, and hatches and will put you in the best possible position. We will communicate with guests at least 24 hours before a trip on where we will meet to maximize our success. What skill level do I need? While we specialize in putting experienced clients onto trophy fish, we do also love teaching aspiring anglers. If you are booking a walk & wade trip however, it is important that you are sure on your feet and can maneuver through the rocky and unstable terrain, and have confidence wading in moderately fast-moving water. If you are unsure of your ability to walk & wade, consider booking a float (drift boat) trip, but that will involve some whitewater/ rapids, and you may have to help portage the boat. Please don't hesitate to drop us a line. What type of fishing will we do? It will depend on what the fish are biting! In the fall and spring we tend to have more success throwing streamers, and in the warmer summer months we focus on tight-line (euro) nymphing. Gilligan was one of the first to employ tight-line techniques in the West, and is largely attributed to it's now common use on the Truckee and beyond. If you're interested in learning this radically efficient technique, he'd be happy to teach you! The main differentiator between this nymphing style and more conventional tactics is the use of a fluorocarbon line and "sighter" instead of a traditional fly line and "bobber/indicator". Instead of being constrained by the speed of a bobber on the surface, tight line rigs dredge nymphs through targeted depths of water columns and travel exactly at the speed of the water at those depths, presenting a much more accurate meal for picky trout. Our Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) section is designed to provide you with clear, concise answers to common queries about our services. What is the rental rate? The rental rate is $400 for 4 hours. Each additional hour is $100. Do you deliver the mobile arcade to any location? Yes, we deliver the trailer anywhere you'd like. For locations beyond a 20-mile radius, we charge $2 per mile. What is included in the basic rental package? The basic rental package includes our custom-built mobile arcade featuring four basketball games. How do I book this Hoop Trailer for my event? You can book us by visiting our website and clicking the "Book Now" button or contacting us directly via phone or email. Is there a deposit required to reserve a date? Yes, we require a 50% deposit to secure your booking. The other 50% is due within 7 days of your event. What is your cancellation policy? Our cancellation policy will be detailed in your booking confirmation. Generally, cancellations made within a certain period prior to the event may incur a surrender of your deposit. Can the mobile arcade be set up indoors? Yes, our mobile arcade can be set up both indoors and outdoors, provided there is enough space and access for the trailer. How much space is needed for the mobile arcade? The space required will depend on the venue layout. We recommend an area that can comfortably accommodate the trailer and allow for safe gameplay. The trailer is 10’ tall, 8.5’ wide and 18’ long. Do you provide staff to manage the arcade during the event? We typically arrive to your event 15 minutes early to get set up. Our staff will go over the games and the trailer with you and answer any questions you may have. Then we leave the event and come back at the end of your party. The games and trailer don’t require any supervision so we are confident everything will be just fine. What if I need additional hours beyond the initial booking? 4 hours is our minimum. Additional hours can be added for $100 per hour. It's best to arrange this in advance, but we may be able to accommodate last-minute extensions depending on availability. Find out about Suspension Service Service FAQs How expensive is it to check a bike? Good news, bike checks are free! We'll take a look and let you know what's going on, no charge. How much do bicycle mechanics charge per hour? We don't do hourly rates. We keep it simple with fixed-price service packages, and they're usually a better deal! How much do bike shops charge to fix a puncture? Most of the time it's about $15 if you just do it by itself. If you bundle it into a service package, labor is 60% off. How much does it cost to replace bike parts? It depends on the part. It could be $6, or it could be $150. If you go with one of our service packages, a lot of those parts are included -- like a full drivetrain swap is included in our Level 2! How much does it usually cost to repair a bike? Most service packages start around $90 and go up depending on what your bike needs. How much is an average bike repair? A solid once-a-year tune-up usually lands around $150. How much is it to patch a bike tire? We don't patch tubes How long should it take to service a bicycle? Quick stuff can be done in about an hour. Bigger jobs usually take a couple days depending on the queue. If it's going to take longer, we've got loaner bikes to keep you rolling. Are bikes high maintenance? Some are, yeah. The more high-tech the bike, the more upkeep it needs. Especially with internal cables or electronic parts. Those need a little extra love. Is it cheaper to buy a new bike or fix an old one? Rule of thumb: if repairs are more than half the value of the bike, it's usually time to start thinking about something new. Is it worth it to repair a bike? If the fix is going to cost more than half the bike's value, it might not make sense. But it depends on how much you ride and what the bike means to you. Is repairing a bike hard? Some stuff is easy. Some stuff... not so much. Things like brakes, electronics, and compatibility can get tricky fast. That's where we come in! Is it worth rebuilding an old bike? Sometimes, yeah. But if you're spending more than half the bike's value, it's usually better to look at a new one. What is bike repair called? If we're keeping your bike running smooth, that's service or maintenance! If something's broken and needs fixing, that's repair! What is the average lifespan of a bike? Frames can last a really long time---sometimes a lifetime. Most parts wear out in a couple years depending on how much you ride. What is the most common bike repair? Definitely flat tires. It happens to everyone. Do you tip bicycle repair? Nope, no need. How much should I pay for a good bike? Rough starting points: - Regular bikes: around $600 - E-bikes: around $1,200 (And yes, we usually have some solid deals below that too.) Can you repair a bike yourself? You can definitely try, but some stuff needs special bike tools and know-how. If it gets complicated, we've got your back! Can I service my bike myself? For sure. Basic stuff starts at home. We even do clinics to show you how. Can a carbon frame be repaired? It can be, but it's tricky. It voids the warranty and can change how the bike rides. We don't do those repairs, but there are companies that specialize in it if you want to go that route. How do I fix a flat tire on a bike? Best way to learn? Come to one of our free flat repair clinics! We'll happily walk you through it. Safe Buying Guide for Trek & Bontrager Products Skip to content {{ $t('header.link.login') }} United States / English {{ $t('header.link.account') }} {{ $t('login.register') }} Safe Buying Guide for Trek & Bontrager Products Safe Buying Guide for Trek & Bontrager Products A quick guide to making sure you're really buying a Trek With the rise of e-commerce, there has also been a rise in fake websites that advertise products that you are interested in at very low prices. These websites exist only to deceive people and take their money. We care deeply about the security of our customers as well as the integrity of our products and brand. Trek and Bontrager products are exclusively sold by Trek and its authorized retailers. What to look for: The deal is too good to be true If an advertisement is telling you that the bike you want is now 70%-90% off, they are lying to you. Do not click on the ad. Do not give them your money or any personal information. The contact information is suspicious Trek and our retailers hold ourselves to a very high standard of customer service. If you cannot reach the person you are buying from, do not buy from them. The site is relatively new You can check to see how long a website has existed by entering it into archive.org. If the site is brand new and offering steep discounts, do not purchase anything from them. The site does not ask you to pick a preferred retailer All current model Trek bikes ordered online must be shipped to an authorized Trek retailer for assembly. If you are not asked to select a retailer to ship a bike to, do not buy from the site. Prior model year Trek bikes can be shipped directly to consumers, but only through an authorized retailer’s website or BikeExchange.com . Ways to check: Check the reliability of the site online Use an online tool such as ScamDoc to check the reliability score of a potential website. Call or email your local Trek retailer Contact your local store prior to purchasing online to verify the website. Find a retailer . Contact Trek customer service Visit our contact us page for information on getting in touch with us directly. If you feel you have been a victim of a fake website If you feel as though you may have given your personal information to a fraudulent website, call your bank or credit card company. Unfortunately, there is little Trek can do if you have given money or information to a fake website. Trek and its retailers do not match prices found on fake websites. pages.text: DOUBLE DOWN GUIDE SERVICE Double Down Guide Service Double Down Guide Service Double Down Guide Service Double Down Guide Service Double Down Guide Service Double Down Guide Service Double Down Guide Service Double Down Guide Service Double Down About Photo gallery Rates Contact More Double Down About Photo gallery Rates Contact Double Down About Photo gallery Rates Contact Lake Tahoe's Premier Fishing Charter and Scenic Tour Lake Tahoe's Premier Fishing Charter and Scenic Tour Lake Tahoe's Premier Fishing Charter and Scenic Tour Lake Tahoe's Premier Fishing Charter and Scenic Tour Lake Tahoe's Premier Fishing Charter and Scenic Tour (530)-721-7253 Lake Tahoe's Premier Fishing Charter and Scenic Tour Lake Tahoe's Premier Fishing Charter and Scenic Tour Lake Tahoe's Premier Fishing Charter and Scenic Tour Lake Tahoe's Premier Fishing Charter and Scenic Tour Lake Tahoe's Premier Fishing Charter and Scenic Tour (530)-721-7253 BOOK NOW Fun For Everyone From Youngsters On Their First Fishing Trip To Seasoned Anglers That Travel The World. We cater To Each Group Individually To Ensure A Personalized Experience You Won't Find Anywhere Else. BIG MACKS Monsters Swim Beneath The Surface Of Tahoe. The Lake Record Mackinaw Was Over 37 Pounds. We currently have the biggest catch on the lake in the past few years, 25 lb 43" lake trout. So come on out and test your luck, maybe you'll catch a bigger one! Catch And Release Or Fill The Freezer Lake Tahoe Is Home To Rainbow, Brown, Cutthroat, And Lake Trout, And Kokanee Salmon As Well, All Of Which Make Great Table Fare. Organic Free Range Fish From Lake Tahoe Is Some Of The Healthiest Protein On Earth. Whether You Prefer Filleted Or Gutted, Fish Processing Is Available At No Extra Charge. Top Quality Light Tackle We Provide Everything You Need To Fish Including Rods From Fenwick And Velocity Equipped With Okuma Line Counter Reels. From Trolling To Jigging We've Got You Covered. Fully Enclosed PilotHouse Our Boat, The Skagit Orca Was Designed To Handle The Rough Waters Of The Pacific Northwest. With An Enclosed Cabin You Can Get Shade From The Sun or Shelter From The Elements, Weather Is Not An Issue. Equipped With A Supercharged 250HP Outboard It Doesn't Take Long To Get To Our Fishing Spots. Captain Nijal Wheeler With A Passion For Fishing From A Young Age, Captain Nijal Was Somewhat Of A Guide Even In His Youth. Scouring Paper Maps (Pre Google Earth) To Find Farm Ponds To Fish For Bass. It Wasn't Rare For His Friends To Catch Their First Fish At One Of His Honey Holes. Now Decades Later He Still Has The Same Passion. USCG Licensed With 20 Years Of Fishing Experience On Tahoe He Has Earned A Good Reputation Amongst The Fisherman Of The Sierra's. From Commercial Fishing In Alaska To Hiking The Backcountry For Golden Trout, There Isn't A Fish That Can Hide From This Guy. MacDuff's Pub After You Get Off The Boat, Head On Over To MacDuff's Pub, Where they Prepare Your Catch And Serve It On A Silver Platter. Blackened, Baked, And Fried To Perfection. It Doesn't Get Any Fresher Than That! Truckee River Guide Trips | Fly Fishing School | International Travel | Kid Friendly FISH NOW Don’t waste time and money getting stuck with the wrong Truckee Guide. Stop worrying about … What experience does my guide actually have? Will they be a good “fit” for my experience level? How are they with kids and families? I’m a veteran angler, can they teach me anything new? You deserve the best fishing experience possible. Thankfully, we’re here to help. What matters to you, matters to us “Hi, I’m Lulana Heron, your personal assistant to the fly fishing experience of a lifetime! I’ve been in your shoes, and understand your time and money are valuable. I’ll answer all your important questions and together, we’ll customize your dream fly fishing class or Truckee River guide trip. You’ve worked hard for your vacation time. I am committed to making it count!” Book Now! Ask Lu Questions First! You can’t have great fishing without great guides Nationally accredited programs Award winning Truckee guides and instructors Over 15 thousand satisfied anglers Private, stocked ponds for beginners classes Trusted by top brands Truckee/Tahoe/Reno’s top outfitter since 2006 Fish Now Play Video Play Video Truckee River Guide Trips & Fly Fishing School Options Whether you’re an expert angler or a first timer, we have your covered! Truckee River Guide Trips Truckee River, Little Truckee, Middle Fork of the Feather. It's hard to pick just one! Beginner Fly Fishing Classes Fun & easy fly fishing classes on our private, stocked ponds! Corporate Team Building Treat your group to an incredibly unique experience! Creek Creatures Kids Class Casting, fishing and bugs - The perfect pick for all future fly fishers! Hosted Travel Join Matt as your host to experience the world's finest destinations and lodges! But don't just take our word for it... Hundreds of 5 Star Trip Advisor Reviews “ “ My son in law and I took Matt's beginners Cast N' Catch class and really had a great time with him and his associate Finn. Both were very helpful, great tips and information and very patient. I highly recommend his class and hopefully get to spend some more time with him and Finn the next time we are in Truckee. Hopefully, we can get a chance to fish with him on the rivers. ” Barry C. “ “ My group (two boys and their godfather) took the Cast n' Catch class on a very windy afternoon. Matt and Fin were fabulous. Very patient and very knowledgeable. I would recommend this class to all levels of fly fishermen. The day fishing on the Little Truckee was everything advertised. Matt and Dan were simply fantastic. The enthusiasm by both was awesome. They truly cared about our experience and worked very hard to make our day of fishing unforgettable. It worked. I would highly recommend Matt Heron Fly Fishing to anyone who wants to catch fish, learn from the best, and enjoy a day you will remember forever. Hats off to Matt and his crew. We will be back for sure. ” Dick L. “ “ Great day on the Truckee River. Matt Heron is in exceptional fly fishing guide. He clearly knows the river and provided a great fishing experience. Very attentive. Socially gifted. Highly professional. I would recommend fishing with him anytime anywhere. ” Eric H. “ “ Matt Heron FF is professional, responsive and know the local waters. I booked on short notice and was treated like a long time client. Use them! ” Mark C. “ “ I wanted to take my dad fly fishing for his bday but had no clue where to start. I was so lucky to find Matt Heron Fly Fishing. My dad is an experienced fly fisherman but just didn’t know the area very well and I have never fly fished before in my life. Our guide Dan was amazing! He was so knowledgeable and a great teacher. My dad was extremely happy with all the information and knowledge about the area and Dan even showed him some new techniques. And he had me casting really well by then end. We both caught beautiful trout throughout the whole day. Highly recommend this place for lessons or guided fly fishing! ” Danni T. Beachfront locations with Lake Tahoe as a backdrop are perfect for capturing beautiful wedding photos. The Recreation Complex offers a variety of rooms and outdoor amenities to host family gatherings or celebrations for private events. Lakeview Commons at El Dorado Beach is popular for public special events and fundraisers of all types. Additional park amenities with covered gazebos, BBQ, and playgrounds are available to make your next special event a memorable one. What is a Private Event? "Private Events" are defined as events that are open only to your guests such as a wedding, family gathering, or private celebration. If you are interested in booking your private event at City Recreation and Aquatics Center, please check out our facility rental calendars to see availability at our various event venues. What is a Public Event? "Public Events" are defined as events that are open to the public with or without an entrance fee, may have vendors and/or serve food, and are publicly advertised. All public events held within city limits or on city property are subject to completing the City Special Event Application . Commercial Use of Parks A Commercial Use of Parks Permit (CUPP) is required for any individual or business conducting fee-based or revenue-generating activities in City of South Lake Tahoe parks. This includes fitness classes, camps, and other organized programs. To learn more about requirements and fees, please visit our Commercial Use of Parks Permit page. Surefoot Orthotics are the first step in creating a proper fit inside your ski boots. The orthotic holds your feet in their strongest, most stable position, and as a result, you’ll be able to ski better with less effort all day. You must visit one of our 29 locations so we can scan your feet using our proprietary technology. It helps you maintain direct contact with your flies, improve drift control, and detect subtle strikes—especially in fast, technical water like the Truckee. Without it, line can slip between the spool and frame, leading to frustrating tangles and lost efficiency. A full cage keeps everything contained and running smoothly, so you can stay focused on maintaining tight contact and fishing your drift effectively.
